Keeps his eye firmly on the ball, fumbles it three-four times but eventually hangs on with a slide. Superbly done by Thakur. Rahane looked to go over the bowler against the length ball but has to walk back now.

name: VR Iyer
commentary: Venkatesh's short, dashing stay ends. Pulls the length ball straight to Axar at deep square leg. Despite not having enough room to free his arms for the pull, he made a good contact. And that brought about his downfall. Early strike for Capitals.

name: SS Iyer
commentary: gone, stumped! Kuldeep hits back right away. The googly gets the opposition captain out. Pitches it on a slightly good length on off, and gets it to turn away from the right-hander. Iyer is down the track prepared to clobber that over the on side again, but is beaten. Pant has a lot of time to clip the bails

name: N Rana
commentary: finds long-on! Lalit does the trick. Comes back with a wicket one ball after being hit for a six, although it was a dipping full toss on middle and off, but not low enough for him to miscue. Rana cleared his front leg there to facilitate the slog, and found the fielder as he ended up hitting that off the bottom of the bat

name: AD Russell
commentary: swatted right to the man at deep point! Tries to get on top of the bounce of this short of a length ball on off while hopping in the crease, and finds the man there for an easy catch

name: SW Billings
commentary: goes slogging, and falls! Taken by Lalit running forward from fine leg. Billings was sitting deep in the crease, and again went across off to try and repeat that slog sweep. The ball was full and outside off, and he could only send that high up without any real timing. Knight Riders staring at a defeat now?

name: PJ Cummins
commentary: given leg before, and Cummins' dream ends for the day! But he has reviewed. Goes swinging to the on side, but is beaten by that good length ball on middle which is turning in, and is hit on the back leg. There is no inside edge, and the impact appears to be outside leg. Ah, it pitches in line and shows umpire's call on hitting leg stump. So the decision stands, as Cummins is left frustrated

name: SP Narine
commentary: taken at long-off! In and out for Narine. Fuller line and again a little wide of off, turning a tad away after pitching. Narine is ready and prepared to send that into the stands, but can send that only wide of long-off, where Powell does well to keep watching it

name: UT Yadav
commentary: excellent take by Kuldeep! Oh my, catch of the year so far! Kuldeep rans across to his right, and ends up almost where an imaginary midwicket would have been placed. He keeps focusing on the ball while continuing to sprint, and has to stretch out his hands to his right to complete the grab! Pant was chasing the ball too, but gave up there. Fullish ball on middle, and Umesh went sweeping but top-edged it

name: Rasikh Salam
commentary: game over, as Thakur takes his second! Rasikh looks to have some fun by lofting that full ball on middle, but ends up ballooning the ball towards long-on, as Powell runs forward for another catch

name: CV Varun
commentary: No Commentary

name: JC Buttler
commentary: what a start to your spell! Buttler's stumps rattled, and Avesh has struck. Full around off stump, angling in to the stumps as Buttler tries to welcome him with a sloggy swipe to long on. Misses the connection, and Avesh hits bulls eye

name: D Padikkal
commentary: around the stumps. Full on off. Padikkal goes for a reverse sweep, but he's top edged it only for first slip to eat him up! Padikkal tried to hit it over conventional short third man, but was through the shot too early. Gowtham starts with a bang

name: SV Samson
commentary: is he lbw on a full toss? Yes! Slides this full toss into the stumps, and Samson misses the flick from near his knee roll. Hits him, and the umpire has an easy decision to make. Samson does not review

name: HE van der Dussen
commentary: bowled 'im! And Rassie is out after a boundary. Gowtham continues around the stumps. Gets this full ball on middle to go straight through. Rassie misses the cut, the ball goes past the blade, and off stump is broken.

name: SO Hetmyer
commentary: No Commentary

name: R Ashwin
commentary: full and wide of off, as he drags that to deep point

name: R Parag
commentary: is that a clean catch by Gowtham at fine leg? Yup, looks like. But the umpire will check even as Parag is ready to walk back. A slower-ball bouncer from Holder on off, and he gets extra bounce. Gowtham has to go low, but takes it well in the end

name: TA Boult
commentary: No Commentary

name: KL Rahul
commentary: peach of a ball! Comes around the stumps, bowls full, ball originates outside off but swings in with the angle. Rahul can't get any bat on it with the late swing, and Boult's angle has worked against Rahul! Through the gap between bat and pad as Rahul tried to mow it through the leg side

name: Q de Kock
commentary: grabbed at long-on! de Kock had to go after Chahal, but he falls. Is it all over for Super Giants? Short of a length and wide of off, as he pulled across the line only to find Parag on the fence. Chahal helps himself to a quiet celebration

name: K Gowtham
commentary: two wickets in three balls! The new-ball master is at it. The Gowtham experiment has not worked, Boult too good for him with the new cherry. Boult comes over the stumps. Full on middle, and angling into leg stump. Gowtham can't get bat on ball.

name: JO Holder
commentary: in the air and mid on - Ashwin - pockets that with ease. Prasidh bowls short of a length, Holder looks to be in position to pull, but the bat's face is looking up, and has sliced the shot in the air. A fist pump from Prasidh as Super Giants go 14 for 3

name: DJ Hooda
commentary: crashed into the stumps! Sen has his first IPL wicket. The middle and leg stumps are shaken. On a good length on middle, as Hooda swings across the line and misses. Hooda was standing on leg stump there, with his front leg out of the way. Clean bowled

name: A Badoni
commentary: straight to long-off! Skips down the pitch early - and he had to get bat on ball once he had danced down - as Chahal went full and outside off. Badoni looks to loft, but finds the fielder bang where he was placed on the boundary

name: KH Pandya
commentary: bowled him around his legs! Pandya was across his stumps really early, and missed his attempted sweep there. Tossed up - and looked like the wrong 'un too - on a fullish length on middle and off. Pandya ended up down on his knees way outside off, and the ball crashed into the stumps as he missed

name: MP Stoinis
commentary: No Commentary

name: PVD Chameera
commentary: animated appeal for leg before, but turned down. And Samson reviews. A yorker length ball on middle and leg, after being tossed up. He had his front leg out of the way, and missed the ball while trying to jam. There is no inside edge there as well. And replays show that would hit the base of middle stump

name: Avesh Khan
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: MS Wade
commentary: an entertaining over comes to a close with a wicket from around the stumps! Malik opts to change the angle for his first ball to Wade in the over, and goes full on off stump. The bowler's angle brings the ball into middle stump, and Wade misses the flick. Hits the front leg, umpire says out, and Wade doesn't bother reviewing that

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Shubman Gill
commentary: Oh that's stunning A flying catch at cover sends Gill back for 7. Bhuvi bowled it in a slot outside off. Gill met it for a drive under his eye, but Tripathi at cover dived to his left, stuck the arm out, and ends up taking a beauty

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: B Sai Sudharsan
commentary: Natarajan wins the battle of the Tamil Nadu players as the ball grips, slows on Sudharsan as he tries to play a drive off a length ball. Hits the top half of the bat, pops up in the air, and goes to Williamson at mid off in slow motion

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: HH Pandya
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: DA Miller
commentary: MJ wins the SA vs SA battle as Miller pays the price for being cramped. Jansen dug it short as Miller came down the track to show some aggression. The pull is mistimed, and midwicket moves to his left to take the catch

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: A Manohar
commentary: Tripathi runs around from long off to the sightscreen and dives to take a catch. Manohar's whirlwind innings ends. Another slower ball, fullish outside off. Manohar is through the shot too early, loses the grip off one hand, and the ball is sliced way up in the air. Applause from the dug out for Manohar

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: R Tewatia
commentary: back of a length on off and middle. Tewatia backs away to clobber a shot square, but misses. Hardik runs across for a bye, Tewatia is slow off the blocks. Pooran throws to Natarajan, and the bowler runs to the wicket and breaks the stumps with an under-hand

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Rashid Khan
commentary: bowled around his legs! Yorker around leg stump. Rashid tried to flick it off his pads. Misses, and the leg stump is broken. Gujarat Titans finish on 162 for 7

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Abhishek Sharma
shorttext: c Sai Sudharsan b Rashid Khan
commentary: short ball on the body, rocks back to try to heave this over midwicket but the ball hustles onto him and cramps him for room. Winds up picking out Sudharsan at deep midwicket 10 yards inside the rope, who takes a knee high catch tumbling forward.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: KS Williamson
commentary: offcutter slower ball full on seventh stump at 122 kph, Williamson tries to drag this with a slog targeting the leg side but instead skies this to long-on. Easy catch taken 20 yards in from the rope by Tewatia casually at chest height.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: RA Tripathi
commentary: and now Tripathi rubs salt into the wound from the delivery to end the last over. Flighted full on fifth stump and launches a drive high over wide long-off. Tripathi was needing treatment on his calf earlier and stumbles backward again after that shot. The physio is back out.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: N Pooran
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: AK Markram
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: RD Gaikwad
commentary: Gaikwad is ruled out lbw. Height the factor? He asks for the review. He didn't connect the attempted heave off a length ball and got hit on the back thigh. Surely high? No! Clipping the stumps! One of those things that goes against you when you are not it form. Looked good but has to walk back. CSK don't lose a review even though they lose a wicket.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: RV Uthappa
commentary: Finally a wicket for RCB and Hasaranga! Breaks the 165-run stand. The non-celebration from the Royall Challengers says it all. Was a googly on the shorter side, Uthappa picks Kohli at deep midwicket to perfection to walk back with 88 against his name.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: MM Ali
commentary: Sensational fielding display. Suyash Prabhudessai making an impression early in the game. Flatter and quicker outside off, cut towards backward point. Seemed to be passing the fielder but for a diving stop. Moeen was down in search of a run and stood no chance of getting back after an accurate throw to the wicketkeeper.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: S Dube
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: RA Jadeja
shorttext: c Anuj Rawat b de Silva
commentary: Just a one-ball stay for the skipper. Hasaranga has two-in-two but that's it from him tonight. Tossed up googly around middle, Jadeja goes for the slog. Gets it high in the air. Rawat at deep midwicket settles underneath it and takes it safely. Something to cheer for RCB.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: MS Dhoni
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: F du Plessis
commentary: swung away but can't clear long-on. Faf had a grimace as he made contact. First wicket in the IPL for Theekshana and it's a massive one. Faf can't make a big one against his former team.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Anuj Rawat
commentary: got him with a super delivery! Theekshana takes off on a celebratory run that would make Imran Tahir proud. Rawat has reviewed. This one cuts back in sharply to beat Rawat, who tries to whip that across the line. He's hit on the back pad and the ball didn't have a long way to travel. he got into a terrible tangle there and ball tracking comes back to show three reds.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: V Kohli
commentary: he has picked out deep square! Dube takes a good catch running in grom the ropes. Mukesh bowls length, gets it to nip back into middle, Kohli whips it uppishly - the timing is good - but it's as if he forgot there was a man in the deep precisely for that.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: got him! Maxwell is beaten by the fizz on this arm ball. Swung through a tad early and missed. The length wasn't quite there to pull. This one rushed onto him as well. RCB in tatters.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Shahbaz Ahmed
commentary: got him this time! Don't need anyone's assistance to pick wickets if you can bowl magicballs like that. It's the carromball that fizzes back in off a length to hurrty Shahbaz into a defensive stroke. Sneaked through the gap to smash into the stumps

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: SS Prabhudessai
commentary: got him! Suyash steps out to hoick him over midwicket but ends up being defeated by the drift and sharp turn away. He swung through a tad early as well, so even if the ball didn't hit the stumps, he would've been stumped. Good knock, terrific intent and we've seen glimpses of something special

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: KD Karthik
commentary: that's the end of that, surely. DK has an absolute mow at this length ball. connected it really well. but he was hitting towards the bigger boundary. And unfortunately also found Ravindra Jadeja at deep midwicket. He was no more than two or three inches from the ropes. He belts out a roar, as does DJ Bravo. What a knock. Under pressure, must say that is a terrific grab from Jadeja. Both feet were off the ground for a split second as the ball lodghed in his fingers. He controlled it superbly.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: PWH de Silva
commentary: this time, he picks out long-on. Backed away to swing, but no timing this time.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Akash Deep
commentary: What a catch! Rayudu, you beauty. One-handed stunner from nowehre. Akash jabs at the ball, gets it high on the bat as it lobs in the air. Rayudu mvoed to his right and threw himself at the ball as it stuck

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Mohammed Siraj
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: JR Hazlewood
commentary: No Commentary

name: MA Agarwal
commentary: finally a wicket for Mumbai Indians. Well bowled by Ashwin. Agarwal is clearing the front leg again to look to go over long-off or straight. Ashwin makes sure he doesn't bowl it under his bat. Just short enough to make him drag it. Agarwal gets the toe end on it, and manages to only sky it as far as long-off. He is filthy with himself

name: S Dhawan
commentary: another slower ball produces a wicket. Fullish length ball on middle, Dhawan tries to go over the leg side again but splices this high to long-on. Pollard stands 10 yards inside the rope and waits a few seconds for the ball to come down into his hands at chest height.

name: JM Bairstow
commentary: slower ball at 103 kph produces a drag on! Good length ball angled across off stump, Bairstow tries to heave this over midwicket but is through the shot early and drags a bottom edge onto the stumps.

name: LS Livingstone
commentary: 143 kph bread and butter yorker! So much for all the people flooding the feedback desperate for a tactical retired out so Livingstone could enter. Bumrah slings in a missile at the base of middle stump and Livingstone can't jam the bat down in time to keep it out.

name: JM Sharma
commentary: No Commentary

name: M Shahrukh Khan
commentary: yorker finally lands on the proper length at 142 kph on sixth stump, Shahrukh tries to punch this out through the off side and it tails in late to produce an inside edge that cannons back into off stump.

name: OF Smith
commentary: No Commentary

name: RG Sharma
commentary: Rabada handcuffs Rohit. He is surprised by this short one, which doesn't give him any room. He tries to short-arm pull it, but gets a massive top edge. Vaibhav Arora gets around from short fine leg, and takes s safe catch. Rohit just didn't have room to push his hands through this one

name: Ishan Kishan
commentary: lovely delivery. Slight shape back in, pitches on a length, middle and leg, and then seams away to take his outside edge. A T20 wicket on a defensive shot. Superb bowling

name: D Brevis
commentary: the drop only costs four runs! Short on the body, Brevis slams a pull flat to deep backward square. Arshdeep is in perfect position and judges it very well coming 10 yards off the rope to pouch a head high catch.

name: NT Tilak Varma
commentary: horrible mixup results in a dreadful runout! Full on the stumps, flicked into midwicket. It was well wide of the fielder and Tilak sets off. Looked like an easy single on there but SKY is ball-watching at the striker's end. The fielder has plenty of time to throw to Arshdeep with Tilak stranded having completed 3/4 of a run. The bails come off with him 10 yards short. Tilak is spewing plenty of unrepeatable as he walks off.

name: SA Yadav
commentary: knee high full toss on middle stump, could've easily disappeared over long-on for six but flubs the heave trying to clear long-on! It goes straight up in the air to Odean Smith 10 yards inside the rope for a straightforward catch at chest height. Smith slams the ball down in a raucous celebration!

name: KA Pollard
commentary: Pollard runs himself out trying to steal a second off a misfield! Full on sixth stump, Pollard drives to long-on and slow jogs the first run. Odean Smith fumbles and SKY suddenly calls for two. There's hesitation from both of them, Pollard puts his hands up to signal he doesn't want to run but then sets off late. SKY stops midway then keeps going. A huge mess. The relay from Smith to the keeper is in time as the bails come off with Pollard two yards short. If Pollard ran the first run hard, there was definitely two there, but he got himself into trouble by slow jogging/walking the first run.

name: JD Unadkat
commentary: another fullish length ball angled across sixth stump, Unadkat goes for a huge heave back over long-on but skies this over extra cover. Mayank backpedals from extra cover on the ring and takes a safe catch at rib height 10 yards from the edge of the circle.

name: M Ashwin
commentary: No Commentary

name: JJ Bumrah
commentary: length ball on fourth stump, slices this high over short third man. Dhawan runs from backward point to circle around and complete another catch before doing his customary thigh slap celebration.

name: TS Mills
commentary: triple-wicket over for Odean Smith to end the match! Length ball on fourth stump, another top-edged slice finds Mayank in the ring at extra cover for another chest high catch. PBKS win by 12 runs.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: MS Wade
commentary: oh Wade's gifts have dried up. That oasis was a mirage. RR have stung him in the second over. Gill walks at Krishna, who bowls the hard length again. Gill drops and runs, Wade responds. Rassie van der Dussen swoops in from cover, and runs down the wicket at the striker's end. Direct hit. Caught short

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Shubman Gill
commentary: oh Parag has got a wicket. Gill a touch too greedy? He doesn't pick the carrom ball, and looks to go over long-on. It is wide outside off, and holds its line because of the finger flick on it. Gill doesn't time it perfectly, and he finds long-on

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: V Shankar
commentary: short, wide, nip away, and and he gets a wicket off what is not his best delivery. Shankar cuts hard but it is too far from him, and manages only an edge through to the keeper

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: HH Pandya
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: A Manohar
commentary: looks for a repeat dose, but Chahal is too clever for that. He pulls the length back, bowls quicker, and on the leg stump. Big top edge from Manohar, skies it, and Ashwin takes the difficult catch calmly at short fine leg

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: DA Miller
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: JC Buttler
commentary: Timberrrr! Killer blow from Ferguson. Yorker at 126 clicks, the legcutter. He roars as Buttler's blitz ends. Such a contrast to the previous delivery that was north of 146 clicks. Buttler had no clue against it, misses digging it out and trudges back ten times slower than his knock. How big a blow is this for Rajasthan?

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: D Padikkal
shorttext: c Shubman Gill b Yash Dayal
commentary: And finds slip without fuss! Length ball outside off, gets good bounce due to his height. Padikkal goes for the punch, cramped for room. Gets a thick outside edge to Gill, who times his leap perfectly. A but of mirror image to the Vijay Shankar dismissal in the first innings. Early IPL success for Dayal.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: R Ashwin
commentary: Stunning catch by Miller and Ashwin's stay ends. Full ball outside off, Ashwin is deep in his crease. Looks to smash it through covers but finds Miller at short cover, who dives low to his left and pouches it safely.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: SV Samson
commentary: Bull's eye from Hardik Pandya! Gujarat are on the money. Samson was nowehere in the frame. Pushes the quick, full ball straight to mid-off and takes him on. Wasn't on the front foot and took that extra millisecond to take a start. Costs him. Rajasthan in deep waters now.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: HE van der Dussen
commentary: Nicked behind! Van der Dussen has to walk back now. Fuller and outside off, angling away from over the wicket. No footwork from the batter and all he manages is a thin edge behind. Royals falling apart...

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: SO Hetmyer
commentary: Toe-ender finds long-on! End of the Hetmyer show. It was a length ball angling in, he looks to go over long-on but fails to get the distance. He was tired as well and has a look at the bottom of his bat.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: R Parag
commentary: Holed out to deep midwicket but was it over waist high? They are having a check. Was a high full toss that Parag failed to get under. Replays show that it was alright. He was slightly crouched and yet it wasn't above waist. Parag is not happy but he has to walk back.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: JDS Neesham
commentary: Hardik bats, Hardik bowls, Hardik fields and Hardik catches it off his bowling too! It's his night tonight. Slower offcutter. Neesham looks to go across the line but ends up getting a top edge. Easy catch for Pandya moving towards mid-off.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: M Prasidh Krishna
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: YS Chahal
commentary: Slower delivery from Dayal, Chahal is early into the shot. It was bowled back of the hand. All he manages is to get it in the air towards point, where Vijay runs in and pouches it.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: KR Sen
commentary: No Commentary

name: VR Iyer
commentary: What a delivery! Length ball, pitching just outside off on a length, and Venkatesh's lack of footwork does him in. Barely half-forward to drive this, and that creates a big gap between bat and pad for the ball to seam back through and crash into the stumps

name: AJ Finch
commentary: inside edge, and Finch's debut innings for KKR ends early. Length ball, angling across the right-hander and veering back in slightly, late. He's in an open position, looking to sit back and punch through mid-off, and he ends up getting a thin inside-edge on it through to the keeper

name: SS Iyer
commentary: 148.8kph, in the blockhole, and bails fly all over the place. Perfect response to the batter moving all around the crease. Again tried to make room to target the off side, and ended up exposing all his stumps to a fast, straight, full one

name: SP Narine
commentary: got him, not the most dangerous delivery he's bowled, but he'll take it. Low full-toss angling into middle and leg, and Narine, looking to make room and slice the ball over point, fails to get the desired elevation even though he hit the ball quite cleanly. Straight into Shashank Singh's hands

name: N Rana
commentary: Natarajan gets his man! Or does he? Rana moved away to smash one over the off side as Natarajan spears one full outside off. Seemed to be a sound as he missed and the ball went to the keeper. The keeper and the bowler appealed but the umpire stayed unmoved. Sunrisers take it upstairs and find that there's a spike as the ball passes the bat. Rana has to depart. There was a definite sound in real time too.

name: SP Jackson
commentary: And then he goes! Umran comes back in some style. Chest high short ball on off, too quick for Jackson. Goes for the pull and gets a top edge towards fine leg. Seemed as if Natarajan wasn't under it but adjusted well to take it safely with a dive forward. End of Jackson's action.

name: AD Russell
commentary: No Commentary

name: PJ Cummins
commentary: Catching practice for Jansen. Length ball outside off, it was the legcutter. Cummins gets more height than distance. Long-on runs in and completes it easily.

name: Aman Hakim Khan
commentary: Cleans up Aman Khan! A spinner and his deception skills. Was bowled with the index finger and the thumb, angling in to Aman. He goes for the swipe across the line but misses and loses his leg stump. Russell off-strike still, just what Sunrisers wanted.

name: UT Yadav
commentary: No Commentary

name: Abhishek Sharma
commentary: not the greatest over of Abhishek Sharma's career. Back of a length again, a little closer to off stump, and Abhishek looks for the pull, once again without moving his feet a great deal. Ends up bottom-edging into his stumps

name: KS Williamson
commentary: got him, Russell's hard lengths produce the big wicket. 139.3kph. Back of a length this time, not as short as the previous ball, though the line is similar, and it seemed to come in off the deck like an offcutter. Williamson looks to pull again, and only succeeds in inside-edging into his stumps. Both openers have played on while looking to pull

name: RA Tripathi
commentary: Russell gets back at him in the tamest manner possible. Off-pace offcutter on a length around off. Tripathi stands tall and pulls it straight to Venkatesh at long-on. Tripathi cannot believe what he has done and has a lot of stern words with himself as he trudges back. Lots of gestures involved too. End of the 94-run partnership with that.

name: AK Markram
commentary: No Commentary

name: N Pooran
commentary: No Commentary

name: KL Rahul
commentary: No Commentary

name: Q de Kock
commentary: Allen provides MI with the breakthrough. Given out lbw. This looks fairly adjacent, and de Kock decides against a review. Much fuller and darted into middle, too full for the sweep or the reverse-sweep rather. The ball also skids off the deck and thumps the pad in front of middle. Looks plumb although ball-tracking returns umpire's call on leg stump. Some respite for MI

name: MK Pandey
commentary: Knocks over leg-stump with another flighted delivery! It was full and invited the slog-sweep which Pandey went for but was beaten comprehensively by the ball that came in with the angle, the leg-spinner may have spun away a bit to to hand Ashwin his first wicket

name: MP Stoinis
commentary: Bottom-edge skier goes high and is taken low-down by Rohit at cover! It was full outside off and was angling away, Stoinis flashed at it with a horizontal but could not reach far enough to find the middle. Rohit kept his eyes and almost let it slip as he was going down with a crouch but managed to hold on.

name: DJ Hooda
commentary: Caught behind off the upper-cut! The slower bouncer was close to going above the head but Hooda went through with the shot and bottom-edged it to the keeper who took it comfortably. No celebrations.

name: KH Pandya
commentary: No Commentary

name: Ishan Kishan
commentary: Two in two overs for LSG as Stoinis produces a drag-on. Offcutter into the pitch from Stoinis, Kishan wants to force it away through the leg side, he can only chop it back onto his own stumps. Kishan is filthy with himself for giving his wicket away once again

name: RG Sharma
commentary: Has Rohit nicked off? Yes, the finger goes up. De Kock goes low and pouches a low catch. Back of a length and keeps veering in from outside off with the angle from over the stumps. Rohit searches for the dink down to deep third man, but doesn't have enough room to work with. He simply guides this 141.3ks delivery into the gloves of de Kock

name: D Brevis
commentary: Drilled straight to Hooda at extra-cover. Avesh gives Brevis a send-off. Brevis pre-meditates by shuffling outside leg, even before Avesh delivers. Full-toss on middle stump, belted more or less straight to the infielder. It was hit hard, so Hooda did a good job hanging onto the ball. Brevis' fireworks are over

name: SA Yadav
shorttext: c sub (K Gowtham) b Ravi Bishnoi
commentary: Long-hop is pulled to deep square-leg! It was slow and went over middle and leg, Surya turned and tried to pull it hard but got the top-edge and Gowtham took it comfortably at the deep. Yadav played well but could not finish things off, Bishnoi will take it however they come, particularly off his last over.

name: NT Tilak Varma
commentary: Yorker hits off! It came in with the angle. Tilak had made room and tried to dig it out to the offside but could not get the bat down in time and gets castled. Holder punches the air in celebration.

name: KA Pollard
commentary: Taken at deep mid-wicket! It was full just outside off, close to a yorker and took the bottom of Pollard's swinging bat and was taken in front with a lunge and a tumble by Stoinis

name: FA Allen
commentary: Flayed, goes to short-third man off the edge! It was full outside off, he tried to whack it over long-off with his front-foot out the way but found Chameera, who took it comfortably with his hands pointing up

name: JD Unadkat
commentary: Run-out comes in as they tried to attempt the second! It was full outside off, close to a yorker and was dug-out to deep mid-wicket with an attempted heave. It went along the ground and Stoinis sped in to stop and threw it at a good height to ensure Pollard could not get back.

name: M Ashwin
commentary: Run-out on the non-striker's end comes in from an attempted bye! It was full outside off and beat the swinging horizontal bat, Pollard ran in and the underarm through beat the striker's end. The bowler took it and underarmed it to the stumps at the other end

name: JJ Bumrah
commentary: No Commentary

name: TS Mills
commentary: No Commentary

name: F du Plessis
commentary: big wicket. Du Plessis taken out before he can start accelerating. That deep point instead of a third man has worked. Du Plessis skips down the track, Khaleel shortens the length, de Plessis slashes at it in an upper-cut, and Axar Patel runs to his right to complete the catch

name: Anuj Rawat
commentary: that is plumb. Full, shaping in, at the middle stump, and Rawat falls over trying to whip this square on the leg side. Doesn't show it the full face of the bat

name: V Kohli
commentary: Lalit Yadav has hit the single visible stump. Off we go to the third umpire. What an incredible piece of fielding. He has caught Kohli short with a direct hit while being off balance. Kohli again looks to drop this to point and run. Maxwell knows it is too close to Lalit, and sends him back. Lalit is falling over as he lets the ball go, and catches Kohli short by a frame

name: GJ Maxwell
shorttext: c Lalit Yadav b Kuldeep Yadav
commentary: and immediately he gets his man caught at long-on. Nice dip on this, Maxwell looks to go downtown with this, but just gets it on the toe of the bat. And he is looking to just play through the line and not hit the pants off this ball. Easy catch for long-on

name: SS Prabhudessai
commentary: mis-times the reverse-pull. He switches his stance early, Axar drags the length back, Prabhudessai still manages to get some bat on it, but the fielder at point, Kuldeep, times his jump perfectly to catch him overhead

name: Shahbaz Ahmed
commentary: No Commentary

name: KD Karthik
commentary: No Commentary

name: PP Shaw
shorttext: c Anuj Rawat b Mohammed Siraj
commentary: the stand is broken and the blazing partnership has been stopped. Shaw got a bit overshadowed by Warner's assault after his initial blows. Siraj goes length outside leg stump having seen Shaw back away, and the batter is cramped. Tries to clobber a slog over the leg side, but mistimes it in the air. Anuj Rawat gets under it in the deep

name: DA Warner
commentary: switch hit! Can't connect! LBW appeal! Not given! But Royal Challengers review. Full on the left-hander's middle stump. Skids into the left-hander's off stump. Three reds according to the TV umpire and the umpire has to change his decision. Kohli gives a big fist pump, the camera pans to Warner's daughter in the stands who looks very sad. The Capitals dugout gives Warner a warm welcome back into the dugout

name: MR Marsh
commentary: what a way to get out! Full ball on middle stump, and Pant hits the straightest of straight drives. Hasaranga moves to his right, sticks a hand out to stop the ball, but the ball hits his finger and rolls onto the stumps! Marsh is not in his crease, and the Aussie has to go for a 24-ball 14. No chance for Marsh to sing a redemption song tonight

name: RR Pant
commentary: hand of God moment! Kohli's athleticism at its best. Siraj tried to bowl a cutter. Ended up as a knee high full toss. Pant wanted to hit it over cover, but ends up slicing the shot. Kohli at cover times his jump to perfection, sticks his right hand up over his head, and the ball has stuck! Siraj strikes, Pant goes, and Kohli is off to celebrate!

name: R Powell
commentary: two wickets in two balls as Hazlewood bowls a fullish ball on a fifth-stump line. Powell wants to feel bat on ball first up, and plays away from his body. Gentle edge and gobbled up by DK. Looks like it was a legcutter, according to the replays

name: Lalit Yadav
commentary: third wicket in less than ten balls as Hazlewood is making deep impact in his return spell. Bowls a short ball, Lalit appears to have connected well with the pull, but there was an outfielder at deep square leg prepared for the ball to come to him.

name: SN Thakur
commentary: How's the Josh? It's high for Royal Challengers as JH takes his third. Starts the over the short ball on a stump to stump line. Shardul goes for the pull, and it's been sliced high up. DK calls for the catch and takes it from point

name: AR Patel
commentary: No Commentary

name: Kuldeep Yadav
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: S Dhawan
commentary: miscues to mid-on and that's the end of Kings' captain for today. Dhawan had been eyeing those quick runs for a while but not getting any success. He dances down again, swings against the short ball and top-edges it to mid-on for an easy catch

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Prabhsimran Singh
commentary: a belated lbw appeal or caught appeal from keeper Pooran, SRH are chatting and chatting about the review call and Williamson signals just in time for the review! Prabhsimran went a long way outside off to flick this to the leg side and UltraEdge shows there's an edge! Pooran caught the ball near his right shoulder and even tried to stump Prabhsimran from far behind while appealing. What a strange, strange appeal, review and dismissal. And just the comeback Natarajan would have wanted

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: JM Bairstow
commentary: loud, loud appeal for lbw, the appeal is not fading at all and the finger finally goes up for lbw. Bairstow gives it a though and reviews. Bairstow went for a sweep for the ball that pitched just outside eoff, it came in with the angle and ball-tracking shows it's hitting middle. Kings lose their review and Bairstow falls for another low score

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: LS Livingstone
commentary: Caressed to cover, Kane takes an excellent catch with a leap and a tumble forward! It was short and wide, looked slow too. Liam, who had been starved of strike, tried to cut it aerially without too much power. He toe-ended it aerially and Kane spotted it early and used his acrobatic skills effectively with forward movements, leap and the tumble.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: JM Sharma
commentary: top edge goes high and Malik takes a return catch by extending his follow through! Rushes Jitesh with his short and fast ball, he pulls but mistimes it and the ball lobs up straight before Umran Malik runs forward and takes it comfortably

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: M Shahrukh Khan
commentary: Short ball outside off is skied to cover! It was wide and short, looked a cross-seamer. Shahrukh tried the aerial cut but got a top-edge that went up for a while but Kane settled in and took it safely with his fingers pointing up

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: OF Smith
commentary: Back of a good length ball is skied to the bowler! It looked a slower one, Smith backed away and tried to whack the pull out of the city but it took the top-edge and went to the leg-side.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: K Rabada
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: RD Chahar
commentary: Off-stump flies behind after being clattered by the full ball! Chahar went across before the ball was bowler and came back far enough to make room and tried to slap it to the off-side but was castled. Umran enjoyed that.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: VG Arora
commentary: Was that a replay? No, it's another rocket that knocks the top of off! This was slightly shorter, the room-making was on again. Vaibhav tried to carve it but missed and the ball smashed the top of the stump to take Umran on the verge of a hat-trick and a wicket-maiden.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Arshdeep Singh
commentary: Tries the full ball on the stumps, again. It's hit to cover. The ball went straight to the fielder who was in. The batter took-off but the throw came in to the keeper who whipped off the bails, the batter was stuck in the middle.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Abhishek Sharma
commentary: Holes out at long-on! It was full and floated up on middle and off at 85 kmph, Abhishek came down the ground and tried to go over long-on with an extended aerial loft. He got to the pitch of it but the connection was good enough only to hand a comfortable catch in the deep around his bread basket.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: KS Williamson
commentary: taken at mid-off, Rabada gets the big wicket! Williamson started slow today, and he wanted to clear mid-off with that full delivery, but it kind of held in the surface, Williamson was through with his shot and he chipped it towards mid-off where Dhawan went to his left and leapt to grab it with both hands

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: RA Tripathi
commentary: easy catch for long-off, Rahul Chahar strikes! Lovely release from Chahar with good revs, flight and some drift into middle and leg. Tripathi goes for a big shot and miscues it completely for a high and simple catch to Shahrukh who comes in from long-off to get under it

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: AK Markram
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: N Pooran
commentary: No Commentary

name: RD Gaikwad
commentary: hit straight to deep-backward square leg. Was a full toss around off, Gaikwad goes down on one knee but ends up hitting it straight to the fielder

name: RV Uthappa
commentary: fuller and seaming in this time. Uthappa once again looks to smash it through midwicket. Once again he fails to connect. <b>An appeal for lbw but not given. Titans want to review this. No inside edge and the ball-tracking shows it would have gone on to hit the top of middle stump

name: MM Ali
commentary: chopped on! Not for the first time this season. Was a length ball pushed across. Moeen looks to drive through the off side, playing away from the body, but gets an inside edge onto the stumps

name: AT Rayudu
commentary: fuller and wider outside off, 126.3kph. Rayudu had to stretch for it. Fails to get the power behind it and Vijay Shankar pouches it at sweeper cover

name: S Dube
commentary: a full toss around off, Jadeja smashes it down the ground but Miller moves quickly to his left from long-off and fires in the throw. Ferguson collects it and breaks the stumps. Dube was short

name: RA Jadeja
commentary: No Commentary

name: WP Saha
commentary: misdirected from Saha! Jadeja bowls a length ball on middle. Saha rocks back and gets low. Plays across the line aiming for a leg-side boundary, but it's been hit in the air, and deep square leg runs in to end his 18-ball stay

name: Shubman Gill
commentary: golden duck! A dream start for CSK. Choudhary bowled a length ball and offered width too. Gill walked down the ground and cut it well, but it's been hit straight to Uthappa at point, who takes it comfortably from near his head.

name: V Shankar
commentary: another cut, another wicket. Shankar gone for a duck too as Theekshana bowls a length ball quite wide outside off. The ball doesn't turn in either direction, skids straight through, and Shankar tries to play square. Takes the edge, and MSD does the rest.

name: A Manohar
commentary: Titans in tatters! Full ball. Manohar came down the ground and that has caused him his arms to lock. Gets too close to the pitch of the ball by skipping out, and therefore the attempted drive cannot generate the elevation to take it over the infield. Pocketed at cover!

name: DA Miller
commentary: No Commentary

name: R Tewatia
commentary: slower ball. Length ball just outside off. Tewatia comes down and tries to smack it over mid off. But the shot's been toe-ended, the ball's gone high up, and the captain settles under it at mid off

name: Rashid Khan
commentary: put the dancing shoes on, DJ! Bravo bowls a length ball, takes pace off, fourth-stump line. Rashid comes down the track and tries to hammer it, but he slices the shot. Ball goes high up, Moeen runs across to cover from mid off, and takes a running catch. Out for a 21-ball 40

name: AS Joseph
commentary: holes out but the strategy was right. Bravo went fullish outside off, Joseph looked to clobber it over long off, but it's not off the bat's middle. Jordan races in from long off, and takes a catch despite his right leg getting stuck awkwardly on the grass as he was trying to slide in

name: LH Ferguson
commentary: No Commentary

name: JC Buttler
commentary: superb bouncer. Right at his badge, over the left shoulder, and Buttler gets a top edge on the pull. It carries all the way to the fine leg fence where Chakravarhty doesn't have to move. Buttler walks off with his bat and helmet held high

name: D Padikkal
commentary: kisses the bail. Just short of a length, looks like a legcutter release, Padikkal goes back to try to hit it down the ground, but is early into the shot, and misses it altogether

name: SV Samson
commentary: big leg-side boundary here. Russell goes slower ball, on a length, middle and leg, and Samson ends up skying it to deep midwicket. Samson does his job, going at 200 strike rate

name: SO Hetmyer
commentary: No Commentary

name: R Parag
commentary: Parag goes straight over his head, slightly towards long-off. The connection is not the cleanest. Cummins runs to his right from long-off, gets into a sort of a bicycle jump, catches it overhead, and while he is stumbling, he lobs it towards Mavi, who has run to his left from long-on. Mavi completes the catch one-handed with a jump of his own. The scoreboard, though, will say c Mavi b Narine

name: KK Nair
commentary: full and straight, no power in this slog. This is seam up and in the slot. Nair just doesn't make a good connection. Caught at long-on. This is proving to be a good over for KKR

name: R Ashwin
commentary: No Commentary

name: AJ Finch
commentary: The extra balls work out for the Royals as Finch upper cuts a short, wide ball but it finds the bottom of the bat and skies to deep backward point running diagonally to his left. Nair had enough time to settle under it and take it comfortably

name: SP Narine
commentary: Run-out comes from attempting a suicidal run! It was a full ball that was pushed to cover, they took off after Finch called. Narine responded but the run was not on. Hetmyer ran in from cover-point to his right, picked it up and threw it direct at the striker's end to hand a Diamond duck to Narine.

name: SS Iyer
commentary: Given LBW, Iyer reviews! It was a full ball that beat the whip towards deep mid-wicket. Iyer is walking as the Hawk-Eye's prediction comes in, it shows the ball was pitching in line and was hitting leg. Chahal knew it was out right away and roared as soon as it was given out.

name: N Rana
commentary: Full on leg-stump, it is slog-swept but in the air straight to Buttler at long-off! Rana tried to make room and go all in with the bat swing but could not get enough on it. It took the top edge and stayed up for a while in the air, allowing Buttler to settle under and take the catch comfortably

name: AD Russell
commentary: The carrom ball knocks over Russell's defence! It was a good length ball that pitched on middle and turned away ever so slightly, past the full-faced bat to knock off-stump. Ashwin is off on a celebratory run! It was bowled from wide of the crease, which Ian Bishop, observes accentuated the angle

name: VR Iyer
commentary: Googly beats the full-blooded swing down the ground and has Venkatesh stumped! It was a full ball that turned away from off and the batter had danced down the track but missed the ball. The keeper completed the dismissal and Chahal is chuffed!

name: SP Jackson
commentary: Helped straight to short-fine leg! The off-cutter lands on a length and Jackson is early on the shot, he tried to pull it but was early on the shot with the eyes away from the ball. The catch is at the breabasket and is accepted gleefully.

name: Shivam Mavi
commentary: Taken at long-on! A full ball outside off has Mavi reaching out and trying to pull it to the legside, but he only manages to top-edge it. This ball went straight up for Parag to take the catch at a comfortable height and to have Chahal on the verge of a hat-trick.

name: PJ Cummins
commentary: Caught behind! Takes the outside edge of the cover-drive does a full ball spinning away from outside off. Cummins went across and pushed at it. It leads to Chahal celebrating with a leap and a slide to take him to the jolly pose at the boundary with the elbow on the ground. The hat-trick has RR firmly on top!

name: UT Yadav
commentary: Beats the swipe and the ball clatters the stumps!. It was a slow ball on a good length and Umesh stayed legside of the ball and swung through with a close-faced bat but he missed and the bowler hit!

name: CV Varun
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Anuj Rawat
commentary: taken at mid-off. Or is it? Rawat once again looks to hit down the ground but ends up mistiming this fuller delivery. It goes towards mid-off, where Rahul dives forward and across to catch. They are checking upstairs and the third umpire is happy with it, the fingers were under the ball

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: F du Plessis
commentary: Stoinis holds on this time at deep backward square! Results in heartbreak for du Plessis as he ends on his IPL best of 96 once again! Slower bouncer from Holder, Faf tries to smash a front foot pull over the leg side rope but he's out of energy after more than an hour at the crease and it swirls tamely to Stoinis 10 yards inside the rope, who takes a far less eventful chance than the previous one shelled in the over.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: V Kohli
commentary: two in two for Chameera. Kohli walks back for a first-ball duck. A wry smile on his face. Sadness on the faces of some of the fans in the stands. It was short of length outside off, Kohli played at it away from the body. But he couldn't keep it down and Hooda pouches it at backward point

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: a superb catch by Holder. A length ball around off. Maxwell goes for the reverse sweep but fails to middle it. It goes to the left of Holder, going away from him. But he stretches and gets both hands to it. In the end, he completes the catch with his left hand, falling on the ground

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: SS Prabhudessai
commentary: a soft dismissal. Dances down the track to this length ball and looks to work it on the leg side. But looks like it came slower off the surface. Gets lobbed towards short midwicket where Krunal accepts the dolly

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Shahbaz Ahmed
commentary: back of a length on fifth stump, slapped into the covers straight to KL Rahul, Shahbaz sets off from the non-striker's end but Faf wasn't interested. Relay from Rahul goes to Holder on one bounce at the bowler's end as Shahbaz tries to scamper back. It goes to the third umpire to determine if his bat was over the line before the bails are dislodged. Looks like his bat is on the line, but not past the line and a fifty partnership is now toast.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: KD Karthik
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: HV Patel
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Q de Kock
commentary: taken at first slip. A length ball angling across de Kock, who pushes at it tentatively and gets an outside edge. Karthik puts in half a dive, leaving it for Maxwell eventually who grabs it with both hands to his right, just above waist height

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: KL Rahul
commentary: a slower one down the leg side. Looks to glance but misses. The umpire says it's not a wide. RCB have opted for a review. And the UltraEdge shows a murmur as the ball passes the bat. Rahul is surprised, he even gestures to the dugout if there was something on the UltraEdge. Kohli, meanwhile, lets out a roar

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: MK Pandey
commentary: a soft dismissal. Short of length at the body, Pandey goes for the pull but the ball hits him high on the bat. A simple catch for Harshal at forward square leg

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: KH Pandya
commentary: he looked uncomfortable the previous few balls and now holes out to deep midwicket. Slightly short on off stump and sticks in the wicket a touch as Krunal struggles keeping his hands back on a pull. He can't get any power behind it and picks out the man on the rope who takes this five yards in at chest height.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: DJ Hooda
commentary: superb effort at deep third man by Suyash! Short and wide, Hooda goes to uppercut this over the third man rope but gets under it too much. It swirls toward the man charging in from the rope who judges it well sliding on his knees to soften the catch 15 yards in from the boundary.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: A Badoni
commentary: Hazlewood sends down a knuckle slower ball full and very wide outside off, Badoni shuffles away across his stumps and tries to heave this ball from well outside the guidelines into the vacant leg side boundary but pays the price and feathers an edge through to DK.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: MP Stoinis
commentary: cover your children's ears! Stoinis shuffles way way outside off in the context of the previous ball that was not called a wide and is standing almost on the wide guideline trying to play a full ball into the leg side and inside edge's this onto the stumps. He lets out a massive "F*** you!" that can be heard through the stump mic clear as day all the way back to Australia before walking off.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: JO Holder
commentary: bouncer on the body, Holder pulls this and a top edge swirls to deep fine leg. Siraj has to battle the lights coming in off the rope but manages to hang on at ankle height stumbling forward 10 yards inside the rope.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: PVD Chameera
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Ravi Bishnoi
commentary: No Commentary

name: MA Agarwal
commentary: Chops it on! It was a back of a good length that was going away with the angle just outside off, The body went to the left as the bat reached out as he tried to dab it to third man. It took the inside edge and went back to hit the stumps on the bounce

name: S Dhawan
commentary: Whack-pulls a length ball to the keeper! It was going down leg, Dhawan made room and came back across and tried to hard-paddle, whack-pull, what have you past short-fine leg along the ground. It hit the sticker of the bat and went to the right of Pant, who moved and took it well. Dhawan walked straight after before being given by the umpire.

name: JM Bairstow
commentary: Pulled straight to deep-fine leg! It was a length ball on the hips, Bairstow went back in the crease and judged the length well. However, the placement of the pull was the conundrum, as the the Fizz, took it comfortably under the bread-basket

name: LS Livingstone
commentary: Runs down the ground and misses the straight loft, gets stumped! It was a good length ball over off, it straightened after pitching. The major issue was that Liam did not get to the pitch of the ball. The hands came through with the full bat-swing, the bottom hand came off, and so did the bails.

name: JM Sharma
commentary: full ball, and he looks for the sweep. Given out leg before, but he goes for the review immediately. He went across the stumps, and he was looking to get it fine. I think the question will simply be if he got a tickle on it. There's a slight spike, but that comes when the ball just grazes the ground. Goes on and hits the stumps, but with umpire's call on impact. He will have to go, but the review is retained

name: M Shahrukh Khan
commentary: edged through to Pant! That's probably the last surviving hope for Punjab to reach a fighting total. Length ball, angles across him, and he flays at it, but with little feet movement. Gets a decent edge through to the wicketkeeper, as Khaleel wheels off in celebration

name: K Rabada
commentary: fullish, and through his defence! Rabada has a hopeful poke at it, from the crease. Didn't really pick the length or the line properly. The ball goes through as he looks to drive, and it rattles somewhere between middle and leg. Kuldeep has deserved some reward for his spell today, and he gets it today

name: NT Ellis
commentary: Kuldeep strikes again! Just tosses this up, around off, and with the angle of his release, it slides on, and also turns just a touch. Ellis has a tentative attempt at a drive, but his bat also comes down at an angle, and leaves enough room between bat and pad for the ball to sneak in and rattle the stumps

name: RD Chahar
commentary: sweep, and straight to Rovman Powell at deep backward square leg! Chahar has just made too much of a connection with this ball. It wasn't tossed up a lot, but the line was teasing and tempting, angling in and on the stumps, at a fuller length. Probably there for the sweep, but he failed to keep it down

name: Arshdeep Singh
commentary: full, just outside off, and he has a swing and a miss. Wants a single, but won't be getting anything for this. Pant is quick to come over and whip the bails off. Unselfish, that is one way of looking at it, I guess

name: VG Arora
commentary: No Commentary

name: PP Shaw
commentary: Slog-swept to deep-midwicket, where Ellis balanced himself with a side-twist and took over his left shoulder! It was a full ball, tossed up outside off, the sweep got the top-edge and the ball was traveling, but Ellis kept his eye on it and settled in well, and maintained his balance

name: DA Warner
commentary: No Commentary

name: SN Khan
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: RG Sharma
commentary: that is catching practice for mid-on. Just a nothing little push to a length-ball inswinger, unable to keep it down even though he is not looking to hit a boundary off it. Easy catch for mid-on

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Ishan Kishan
commentary: Kishan is on his knees. The off stump has gone for a walk. Swinging yorker. Okay not quite a yorker. A half-volley more like, but it ha swung late, and Kishan has played the wrong line. He is off his feet as he gets into a tangle, and the ball takes out the off stump. Both openers gone in the first over. Projected score 158 now

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: D Brevis
commentary: and Choudhary makes sure Jadeja's drop doesn't cost them much. He sees Brevis walking at him, Choudhary bowls the slower offcutter, in his half, Brevis looks for a sort of upper-cut, but the extra bounce does him in. Edged to Dhoni

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: SA Yadav
commentary: Santner has a wicket finally after the drop in his first over. And he has the big one. Surya has been given no room by the spinners, and they have had a strong leg-side field. So the boundary options for Surya are to go over the leg-side field. He did that against Theekshana, but gets a flat top edge on the same sweep against Santner. Taken at deep square leg

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: NT Tilak Varma
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: HR Shokeen
commentary: down the wicket this time, and again a move a touch too early. Bravo digs in a bouncer, Shokeen goes ahead with a big shot, skies one to mid-off where Uthappa takes it calmly

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: KA Pollard
commentary: and Pollard has found that very straight long-on. This is short of a length, Pollard goes back to pull him down the ground, looking to go dead straight, but he this has come off the toe end and goes shoulder high to that very fielder. CSK overjoyed

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: DR Sams
commentary: dipping yorker. Slower ball dies on him dramatically and hits him on the pad as he is shuffling across for a big hit. Given out lbw. Reviewed too. The only question is if he has got himself outside the line. The replays show the ball dipping, falling inches short of the toe, turning in to impact the pad on off. It returns an umpire's call on impact, but is hitting flush. The original decision stays

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: JD Unadkat
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: RD Gaikwad
commentary: picks out backward point with a half-tracker first ball! Short and wide angled across seventh stump at 139 kph, there to crack with a blistering cut but doesn't keep it down and doesn't try to elevate it either. Middles it straight to Tilak at chest height behind square, where Tilak takes a bunny hop to get his hands in line and cushion the take.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: RV Uthappa
commentary: back of a length angled across fifth stump, Uthappa shuffles across trying to play a short arm jab paddle pull cheekily behind square but doesn't get it wide enough of Brevis at deep backward square leg and picks him out at chest height 10 yards in from the rope for a simple catch.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: MJ Santner
commentary: bounced out! Similar ball that Sams bowled to end the first over that Santner spanked over wide mid-on, but this time bowled tighter on a fourth or fifth stump line to cramp Santner slightly for room. Goes to pull this and top edges this to mid-on where Unadkat waits several seconds for the ball to come down before grasping onto it with elbows tucked into his torso and palms facing in.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: AT Rayudu
commentary: goodness what a ball to get out to! Meatball of a full toss on the knees is skewed to Pollard at long-off! Junk sent down by Sams, but it's clearly his day when he can get a fourth with this kind of ball. Could have easily been deposited over midwicket but Rayudu awkwardly tried to punch this straight back over mid-on and instead it came off the outer half of the bat floating toward Pollard, who charged forward 20 yards off the rope and dove forward to pouch it with his bucket hands.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: S Dube
commentary: perfect delivery, sensational catch! Sams bangs this back of a length in the fifth stump channel at full pace angling it in toward off, flat-footed poke by Dube clips the edge and flies high toward Kishan's left at chest height. He does a salmon leap sideways to snaffle it.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: RA Jadeja
commentary: slower ball lands full and this time within the wide guidelines at 113 kph forcing Jadeja to play at this but he's through the shot too early, shovels this high toward long-off, basic catch taken by Tilak running in and falling forward on his knees to claim it at waist height.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: MS Dhoni
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: D Pretorius
commentary: Pretorius shuffles way across his stumps and misses flicking across the line to a yorker. Looks stone dead live but umpire Oxenford gives it not out and they scamper a leg bye. Rohit calls for DRS immediately. Live, it looked like the ball pitched in line with leg stump. That was the only doubt. If it was, he's a gonner. Ball-tracking indeed shows the ball pitched in line. Oxenford has to overturn his decision to out! Pretorius was so far across his stumps, you could see leg stump showing live, so it was surprising that it was given not out on field.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: DJ Bravo
commentary: No Commentary

name: JC Buttler
commentary: holes out to long on and an exhilarating innings comes to an end. A pat on the back from Samson as he walks back. Fizz went for the yorker. Buttler tried to hit it, and therefore ended up meeting it at a very low full toss height. Gets some connection, but doesn't have the distance. Warner at long on takes a simple one

name: D Padikkal
commentary: Khaleel is back. full ball on off stump. Padikkal tries to flick across the line, but it hits his pad. Khaleel goes for an lbw appeal as the ball rolls away rapidly past short third man for four. Capitals review after the umpire says not out. Is there bat involved? Tough to say since the ball is close to both the bat and the pad. But the umpire says there's a clear gap between bat and ball. And ball-tracking says it's crashing into middle stump. Correct review, umpire was wrong, and Padikkal has to walk back for 54.

name: SV Samson
commentary: No Commentary

name: SO Hetmyer
commentary: No Commentary

name: PP Shaw
commentary: short and wide, backs away to slap this high over cover but makes the mistake of getting it anywhere within 40 yard-radius of Trent Boult patrolling the boundary. It floats in the air long enough for Boult to range 20 yards to his right and takes a safe catch tumbling to his right at thigh height.

name: DA Warner
commentary: the change of angle works! Length ball follows Warner backing away from leg, Warner tries to flick this behind point and a thick edge goes through to the keeper. Warner tries to sell it like he didn't touch it and that it came off the thigh guard. Krishna roars a celebration and then goes through a more formal appeal to the umpire, who gives it out. Warner's sales job fails and he doesn't bother reviewing. Clear edge.

name: SN Khan
commentary: Sarfaraz gifts his wicket to square leg! Fullish length ball on sixth stump, tries to drag this into the leg side with a sweep but picks out Prasidh in the ring, who shuffles to his right taking a catch at neck height just in front of the umpire.

name: RR Pant
commentary: Padkikkal shows Chahal how it's done! Length ball angled across off, Pant goes for a big heave over mid-on but a top-edge swirls over point. Padikkal calls off Samson who was running toward it and rightly so because Padikkal had a better angle and less ground to cover. He settles himself before reaching forward and takes a sharp steepler while going to the ground to cushion the ball as it comes back to earth.

name: Lalit Yadav
commentary: what an over from Krishna! The around the wicket ploy pays off! Slants this on a good length across Lalit on eighth stump, Lalit tries to shuffle across to get in line for a heave to the leg side but only manages to slice a healthy edge behind to Samson.

name: AR Patel
commentary: flighted full on fourth stump, spins back in and defeats Axar's attempted slog sweep, middle and off stump are knocked back.

name: SN Thakur
commentary: length ball on fourth stump, slaps this to wide long-on, Shardul is hesitant turning back for the second but Lalit wanted it and turned hard for the non-striker's end. Riyan Parag charges hard and fires a bullet to Samson, who whips the bails off with Shardul a foot short. His path back to the striker's end didn't help matters. Ran a pronounced zig-zag, probably covered 24 yards instead of 22 trying to make the second.

name: R Powell
commentary: length ball on the stumps, Powell skies a heave behind the stumps and it swirls around for Samson to settle under and take it tumbling to the ground. An anticlimactic end after what happened minutes earlier.

name: Kuldeep Yadav
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: WP Saha
commentary: Soft dismissal. Once again Saha looks to go for the scoop but adjusts himself seeing Umesh bowl the length ball outside off. All he then manages to do is spoon a catch to backward point. End of the 75-run stand.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Shubman Gill
commentary: wicket first ball for Southee, nicked down the leg side! Not a great ball, but lovely seam position for that length ball on middle and leg it goes down further with the angle, Gill wants to tickle it fine but he's done it too fine and Billings grabs it with both hands

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: HH Pandya
commentary: Hardik holes out! How much did his groin issues have a role to play in that? Slower ball on a length, angling in. Pandya stands tall and pulls but doesn't connect well. Rinku Singh hares in and to his right and completes a tumbling catch. Massive wicket at this point for the Knight Riders.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: DA Miller
commentary: Now then! Mavi strikes and his offcutter works. Bowls it on a shorter length, Miller stands back to heave it over the on side. The bounce means that it takes the top edge and settles into the safe hands of Umesh, who takes some steps to his left from point.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: R Tewatia
commentary: Can't keep Rinku Singh away from the ball on the field today. Another slower ball on a short length, slanting away from Tewatia. This time he can't pull it and so tries to take on the bigger boundary. Finds sweeper to perfection instead.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Rashid Khan
commentary: Two wickets in the over for Southee. Using the bounce in the wicket to good effect. Cross-seam ball on a shorter length, climbs as it reaches Rashid. Only spoons a catch to midwicket as he goes for the pull. Two-ball duck for Rashid and Titans are now withering away.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: A Manohar
commentary: Straightaway picks up a wicket! Knows that he is bowling with the longer boundary on his right and lands a slower one on a length. Abhinav gives it his all as he looks to go over deep midwicket but finds Rinku there. No distance only height.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: LH Ferguson
commentary: And it's two-in-two for Dre Russ! Short ball around leg, Ferguson seemed to have connected well on the pull. But picks out Rink at deep midwicket again, who does well to stop just before the rope as his momentum was taking him back.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: AS Joseph
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Yash Dayal
commentary: Is that a catch? Russell is celebrating for sure. What an over this has been from Dre Russ! Wow. Speared in a yorker that reached the batter at ankle eye. Dayal got it off the toe end and straight to Russell, who took a low diving catch. Four wickets in the over and the big West Indian has delivered for KKR!

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: SW Billings
commentary: top edge goes high, Saha gets under it and KKR lose their first! Shami with the bouncer that nips in marginally, Billings pulls but doesn't get in control at all because it's outside off, he can't get on top of it and ends up with a top edge that goes towards leg slip

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: SP Narine
commentary: taken at short fine leg! He expected the short ball, this wasn't a bouncer though, only short of length. He stays back to whip it off his hips, towards short fine leg, and Ferguson does well to go low to his right to get both hands under it

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: SS Iyer
commentary: edged behind, Dayal gets the KKR captain! Fourth wicket in seventh over, and all of them to fast bowlers. Dayal bowls a stifling line to Shreyas with the angle, makes him play outside off with his line around off, and he can only edge it behind to Saha. Dayal leaps with joy to celebrate the big wicket

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: N Rana
commentary: 149.1 kmh, a lone appeal for caught behind but turned down. Ferguson appealed all alone there, he has convinced Hardik and they take the review. Rana backed away a little, probably because of the pace, it was short of length around off, Rana poked inside the line while on the move towards leg, and UltraEdge shows there's a spike, the crowd comes alive as the decision is overturned!

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: RK Singh
commentary: Dayal strikes on the very first ball of the spell. Rinku's stay in the middle ends. Walks down the track to the length ball and looks to heave it away. Only manages an inside edge that Saha takes with a dive to his right.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: VR Iyer
commentary: Brilliant catch from Abhinav Manohar at the deep midwicket fence. But has he touched the boundary cushion? Venkatesh went for the slog sweep against a wrong one that was full in length around middle and leg. Abhinav had his eyes on the ball but his momentum took him back and his back leg is the one in question. It is very close to tell. The cushion hasn't moved, so that is an indication. And that is all the TV ump needs, too. I am satisfied, says the TV umpire and Venky has to walk back. KKR continue to slide, as Rashid Khan picks up his 100th IPL wicket.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: AD Russell
commentary: Is this the decisive catch? Is it the wicket that seals it for the Titans? The decibel levels at the DY Patil stadium have soared. Short ball, tucked Russell up. Yet he continued with the pull and got more height than distance. Ferguson ran to his left and misjudged it by running in before going back to take that with a tumble. Massive. Everybody crowds him in celebration. Hardik's happy at the ropes.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: Shivam Mavi
commentary: Two matches without a wicket and now Rashid has two in quick succession. Another googly on a length, Mavi looks to pull but misses and sees his woodwork disturbed. Rashid knows and lets everybody know who's the boss in the duel.

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: UT Yadav
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Dr DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai
name: TG Southee
commentary: No Commentary

name: F du Plessis
commentary: flattens the off-stump! The previous one nipped in, this one held its line. Faf is squared up by the length, he had to play at that alright, and he did so down the wrong line. What a ball, what a wicket.

name: Anuj Rawat
commentary: another edge, another catch in the slips. Markram dives to his right in front of first slip to catch that. Jansen gets this to move away, drawa Rawat forwardf with the length, he pushes at that without any conviction and gets the edge that is pouched safely.

name: V Kohli
commentary: snuffed him out in the slips! Golden duck for Kohli. A second in a row. Full and angling across, Kohli pushes with hard hands at the one that holds its line, and because he has jabbed at that, it flies at a comfortable height to second slip. Full marks to Williamson for bringing back the second slip for Kohli. He couldn't have asked for an easier offering.

name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: got him! Terrific from Williamson at mid-off. Maxwell looks to clear the infield but skews this off the bottom. Williamson still had to run in a bit from the edge of the ring, which he did, before putting in a full-length dive forward to complete an excellent catch inches from the ground. Didn't take too many replays for the third umpire to uphold the on-field soft signal. Willamson did superbly to get his body out of the way so that he could toll forward without much of an impact as he landed on his elbows. What thinking.

name: SS Prabhudessai
commentary: have they got him? They're looking upstairs. Suyash is beaten as he looks to heave this over square leg. Have to see if his back foot was dragged back before the bails were ripped off. Because this has been referred upstairs, they will have to look for an edge too. Replays confirm there's none. Replays also confirm his backfoot was way outside the crease when the bails came off. Things are going from bad to worse for RCB.

name: Shahbaz Ahmed
commentary: appeal for caught behind. SRH think there was some glove. The umpire was walking across, seemingly to send it upstairs. He does go up to check if this was a clean catch, but there was no doubt as to whether Shahbaz gloved it or not. The catch is clean too and RCB slip into the abyss.

name: KD Karthik
commentary: called wide as he sips it down. DK was looking to sweep, and may have appeared to have got some bat on it. Suchith and Pooran went up straight away and asked for a review. Yes, there's a spike as the ball passes the glove. DK is gone and RCB slip further Pooran did well to hold on despite being blinded, got the ball lodging between his legs.

name: HV Patel
commentary: the off-stump goes on a cartwheel! Harshal plays down the wrong line as this full delivery hits the seam and jags away. Grave mistake

name: PWH de Silva
commentary: the stumps are flattened! Wanindu attempts a mow across the line but missed it completely.

name: JR Hazlewood
commentary: No Commentary

name: Mohammed Siraj
commentary: straight up, so high that Williamson sizes up the distance and trajectory by taking a split second, then runs back two steps, stops and then again moves back to keep his balance as the ball descends ands completes an excellent catch moving to his left from cover. Siraj tried to give it the kitchen sink but had no timing.

name: Abhishek Sharma
commentary: Sharma falls trying to bring up his half-century and end the match all at once with a six! Length ball on fifth stump, shovels this high toward long-on. Easy catch by Rawat shuffling to his right about 10 yards in from his rope, catch taken at chest height.

name: KS Williamson
commentary: No Commentary

name: RA Tripathi
commentary: No Commentary

name: Q de Kock
commentary: Varma's drop costs MI only six runs. de Kock is caught at short cover next ball. Low full-toss on off, de Kock drives weakly and chips it in the air. (Mis)hits it more or less straight to Rohit who snags a low catch in the infield

name: KL Rahul
commentary: No Commentary

name: MK Pandey
commentary: Pandey charges at Pollard and top-edges it to short fine leg. He falls for a run-a-ball 22. Pandey advances at the bowler, Pollard bangs it shorter and outside off to mess with Pandey's pull. Spliced to Meredith

name: MP Stoinis
commentary: Stoinis holes out to Varma at deep midwicket. Rohit applauds it. Slower short ball on the stumps from Sams. Stoinis pulls this chest-high delivery straight to Varma in the outfield

name: KH Pandya
commentary: Pollard now nips out Krunal. Caught at deep midwicket. Cutter from Pollard, takes it away from Pandya. He fetches it from outside off and drags a pull to Shokeen. The Wankhede crowd roars. LSG continue to wobble around Rahul

name: DJ Hooda
commentary: Meredith gets away with that. He knows it and has a wry smile on his face. Short and into the pitch, finishes on the hips. Possibly a slower variation. Hooda flaps it weakly to short fine leg where Brevis pouches the catch

name: A Badoni
commentary: Picks put Pollard at long-on. On-pace full ball on the stumps, Meredith lands this in the swinging arc as well. But Badoni can't get enough elevation on this occasion

name: JO Holder
commentary: No Commentary

name: Ishan Kishan
commentary: An appeal for caught at slip, off a rebound of de Kock's shoe. The umpires have referred it upstairs. Was short and wide outside off, Kishan had to really reach out for it. He ends up bottom-edging it onto de Kock's left shoe and bounces off towards Holder at first slip. A simple catch for him but it almost slips out of his hands as he takes it in front of his face, but he recovers well to hold on to it.
