commentary: cleans him up! The off stump is down and out. Bumrah goes low to sweep this full ball outside off, which is again coming into him. But he plays too early, and is completely beaten by the turn, as the ball strikes the woodwork behind

name: TA Boult
commentary: No Commentary

name: Shubman Gill
commentary: direct hit from midwicket, and Gill is gone! Rayudu with the magic there. Gill came dancing down much before the ball was bowled, as Chahar pitched that on a good length on middle and leg. The ball took his front pad toward midwicket, and Gill set off for a run in a flash. But there was hardly a run there, and so Iyer remained unmoved. But by that time, Gill was already halfway down, and Rayudu had enough time to dislodge the stumps. Gill dived back, but in vain

name: VR Iyer
commentary: and Iyer edges behind first ball! But he reviews belatedly. More drama, as if what we have had so far wasn't enough. Iyer goes flashing at that full delivery wide of off, as he plays with foot movement and away from his body. There is a clear edge, as UltraEdge confirms, and Iyer has to finally walk back

name: RA Tripathi
commentary: speared in quickly, and Tripathi seems to have pre-meditated a reverse sweep. More of a swipe in the end, as he realises the ball is far too full for that shot. Ends up very late on that, as it crashes into the base of off-stump. Just reward for what has been a spell of very clever bowling from Jadeja

name: EJG Morgan
commentary: du Plessis completes a tight catch at the long-on fence! He hsa taken the catch, but knows that the boundary line is just behind him. So he pops the ball back and goes inside the rope. And by the time he is out again, there is enough time for him to complete that take easily. That was coming high and quick to him, as Morgan slapped that good length ball on middle after coming down and making room. Another low score for Morgan

name: N Rana
commentary: No Commentary

name: AD Russell
commentary: gone! Dre Russ is Lord Shardul's latest exploit. It's not a great shot, to be perfectly honest. It's a length ball, just around off, and possibly a subtle change of pace. Russell has wound himself into action and then looked to spank this over midwicket. Just gets the inside edge, and on to the stumps. Quietly makes his way off. That could save Chennai some 20-25 runs right there, you never know...

name: KD Karthik
commentary: gone this time? It's a yorker, and he was looking to run it down towards third man. Collected by Dhoni. It's an umpire's review, but does look out at first glance. Possibly an intended drive to a full ball, with an open face of the bat, but just off the edge.

name: SP Narine
commentary: No Commentary

name: RD Gaikwad
commentary: leading edge popped to cover! Looks to flick this good length ball on middle, but perhaps plays that too early. The ball was again coming into him, and had good bounce too. Morgan leaps on grabbing at that, as Russell roars out after this much-needed wicket for Knight Riders

name: F du Plessis
commentary: short, slashed, and straight to deep point. Lockie Ferguson seems to have overrun it a bit, and looking into the sun, but has done well to adjust and take it behind him to his right

name: MM Ali
commentary: short, slapped down towards long on. Venkatesh Iyer is right by the boundary, and does well to ensure he stays well inside. Another twist in the tale?

name: AT Rayudu
commentary: timber this time! Rayudu with another ambitious skip down the wicket. Has ended up missing a length ball just outside off. Spins back just enough to come back in and tickle off. Welcome wicket for Kolkata at this stage

name: SK Raina
commentary: fullish, driven towards long off. To the left of the man there, and they have pushed the second. It's a good bit of fielding, though, as Varun whips the bails off. Raina is well short. No third time lucky for Chinna Thala!

name: MS Dhoni
commentary: he dares! He perishes! Similar length, but this was the one that goes the other way. Tosses it up a touch. Dhoni this time has no option, with the mounting equation, but to go for a big, booming drive. That leaves a substantial gap between bat and pad, and that's exactly where the ball has gone through

name: RA Jadeja
commentary: straighter ball, and he looks to sweep this. Given out leg before! Jadeja reviews. May have just got him outside off. Though it might stay on umpire's call. Dot ball in any case. It reveals umpire's call on impact. So Jadeja will have to go back. Super Over, anybody?

name: SM Curran
commentary: Curran skips down the track, and looks to clear long off, but he cannot do that. Substitute Kamlesh Nagarkoti dives low to his right and picks it off. No celebration, understandably

name: SN Thakur
commentary: No Commentary

name: DL Chahar
commentary: No Commentary

name: KL Rahul
commentary: out first ball! Holder goes full just outside off. Rahul tries to whip a flick off his waist through midwicket. But mistimed, and not only that, it's been struck straight to the fielder at midwicket. The substitute Suchith grabs that, and Holder gives out a roar.

name: MA Agarwal
commentary: another one! And it's the other opener. Full on middle, and angling into leg. Agarwal goes for the drive, but he's in no position to execute it. Slices the drive, and its a soft dipping catch at mid off

name: CH Gayle
commentary: strikes his front pad, and Rashid gets what he wants after a cerebr-appeal! But Gayle reviews. Full delivery pitching on middle and turning into him to hit his front pad, which seems to be on leg stump. Meanwhile, Gayle is already halfway back on seeing that replay. UltraEdge confirms there is no inside edge, with his bat in front of off stump. Pitches on middle and leg, and hits middle and leg on top on umpire's call. And so Kings retain the review

name: AK Markram
commentary: full-toss on off, but right down to the man at long-off! It was tossed up, and so was dipping to the batter. Markram saw that coming and swung his bat, but seemed to have sliced that from the bottom of the bat to Pandey, who was into the boundary quite a few steps

name: N Pooran
commentary: taken on the return by Sandeep after a bit of a fumble! That was nearly dropped, but eventually Sandeep has it in his hands. Pooran looks to hoick a full on middle and off, which is bowled with a change of pace. But he gets that aerially and off the inside half of the bat to the left of Sandeep, who lashes at it close to his left shoulder. The ball pops out twice, before finally finding a nest

name: DJ Hooda
commentary: outstanding catch by the substitute fielder at cover! Leaps to his left and nabs that one-handed to send back Hooda, who tries to repeat the shot he played to Samad last over. Again he goes to loft that full delivery outside off over cover, but this time fails to clear the man, who files to his left to complete the take. Excellent catch to get a man who could well be impactful in the death overs

name: Harpreet Brar
commentary: No Commentary

name: NT Ellis
commentary: tries to heave that, but can only slice to third man! Pandey takes a good catch running backwards. Bhuvi continues with that good length outside off, as Ellis goes for the swing to the on side but gets it off the outside half of the bat, as the ball is skied to the fielder, who is well into the boundary

name: Mohammed Shami
commentary: No Commentary

name: DA Warner
commentary: Warner's poor form continues! Length ball on off and angling further away. Definitely in the slot for Warner to cut it over point. But when it's not your time, it really isn't your time. Faint edge, and Rahul moves to his left to take the catch. Just the start Kings would've wanted

name: WP Saha
commentary: Saha is run-out after a terrible mix-up! He clips this full ball on his pads toward square leg, and set off. Holder wanted a second and had taken off immediately, with Saha not aware of what was happening at the other end. It was too late by the time he realised, but still went out of his crease to try and complete that. But by then, Bishnoi had already whipped off the bails

name: KS Williamson
commentary: chopped on! Gets the big wicket of Williamson. Between a good length and full. Outside off stump. Willamson looks to punch it through cover, but the ball jags away inwards slightly, and takes the inside edge onto the stumps

name: MK Pandey
commentary: what a beautiful ball! Dream delivery for a legspinner who has the googly up his sleeve. Full just outside off. Pandey presses forward to flick through midwicket. But there's a gap between bat and body...and it's sneaked right through!

name: KM Jadhav
commentary: chopped on! Jadhav looks to tickle that full ball outside off to third man, but the ball is too close to play that shot, as he gets a bottom edge on to the stumps to further send Sunrisers into trouble.

name: Abdul Samad
commentary: flown off the leading edge to short third man! Samad goes to heave that full ball on off to the on side, but gets an edge, with the ball flying to Gayle, where he doesn't have to move to complete the catch. Sunrisers have now lost half their side

name: JO Holder
commentary: No Commentary

name: Rashid Khan
commentary: goes for the pull to this short ball, but skies that to Arshdeep! Rashid makes room to this ball pitched on off, with Arshdeep getting good bounce too. Rashid gets a top edge, as all the bowler has to do is take a few steps to his right and sit under it

name: B Kumar
commentary: No Commentary

name: PP Shaw
commentary: slices that, and balloons it to mid-off! Shaw makes a touch of room to this full ball on middle and off, which is also angling away. Looks to go over the in-field with that loft, but can only sky that to Livingstone, as Royals strike again. The left-armer's angle working there for Royals

name: S Dhawan
commentary: chopped on! Tyagi strikes first ball, although he has some luck favouring him. Good length ball on middle and off, as Dhawan looks to tap at that. Doesn't quite take off from the surface too, as it comes off the lower half of the bat, and bounces just in front of the stumps before rolling over to hit them. Dhawan barely has time to kick that away, as he walks back with a wry smile

name: SS Iyer
commentary: that could be gone! Drew him forward by tossing it up, and throwing it a touch wide. Iyer took the bait, and saw the ball spin across his blade, and then Samson was quick to whip the bails off. The Royals captain looks quite confident, but it does seem Iyer had his foot grounded, at first glance. Outstanding bit of bowling from Tewatia, nonetheless. Seems to have read a hint of restlessness on the part of the batter. No edge on this. And he had failed to stretch his back foot back in! Pant, and now Iyer. Capitals have some work to do now to get themselves up to the kind of total they should be aiming for

name: RR Pant
commentary: plays this one on! Back of a length is the way to go on this pitch, it would seem. Short, and outside off, and Pant was looking to hook this away towards deep square leg. Ends up getting an under edge, and has to trudge off. Royals with an important breakthrough, because this partnership was beginning to look a touch ominous for them

name: SO Hetmyer
commentary: yorker, and he looks to go down the ground. Off the edge, and taken at short third. Easy catch for Sakariya, as Hetmyer throws his head back in disappointment. Terrific hand, but Delhi would have willed him on to carry on for atleast another couple of overs

name: Lalit Yadav
commentary: No Commentary

name: AR Patel
commentary: pulls a short ball just outside off, down Miller's throat at long on. Patel cannot believe how precisely he has placed it. He walked towards the ball a bit, and inadvertently ended up cramping himself for room. May have actually wanted to go straighter down the ground, but Sakariya is not complaining

name: R Ashwin
commentary: No Commentary

name: LS Livingstone
commentary: tickled behind to the keeper, and Pant grabs it really well to his low! Avesh sees Livingstone coming down early, and changes his pace to also bowl short of a length outside off. Livingstone has a swing at that, but is foxed by the lack of pace, as the ball takes his a faint edge to go toward Pant, who dives low to complete the ctach

name: YBK Jaiswal
commentary: Capitals go up for a caught behind, but the umpire stays unmoved! But Pant reviews. There seemed like a clear sound when the ball passed the bat, as Jaiswal went driving at this full delivery in the channel outside off. And UltraEdge confirms an outside edge. No foot movement as he goes pushing at that, as Pant took it easy this time. Another blow for Royals really early into the innings

name: SV Samson
commentary: No Commentary

name: DA Miller
commentary: dances down, and is stumped! Miller skipped down well too early, as Ashwin tossed that up full and just outside off. Miller is beaten by the flight and the slowness of the ball, and Pant has it easy behind the stumps. Ashwin strikes second ball, as Capitals edge ahead early. Royals three down in under five overs

name: MK Lomror
commentary: helps a short ball down deep fine leg's throat! Dug in short by Rabada, and Lomror might have been intending to play this a bit squarer. Cannot keep it down, and a grateful Avesh Khan gobbles this one up. Exposes the slight underbelly that this batting lineup has for Rajasthan

name: R Parag
commentary: fired in quicker, and he looks to play this across the line, and misses out. Parag misses. Patel hits. Rajasthan sink further deep

name: R Tewatia
commentary: short, and looks to pull it. Cannot keep it down, and it goes straight down Hetmyer's throat at deep square leg. Just has to move a bit to his left, and that's good enough to pull this catch off

name: T Shamsi
commentary: No Commentary

name: V Kohli
commentary: short-arm jab straight to deep midwicket! Just beyond the slot length. Kohli looks to whip a flick over cow corner for six. But because it's a bit too full, he can't get the bat totally under it. Jadeja makes no mistake on the boundary line. Bravo with the breakthrough, Kohli falls victim to the nelson.

name: D Padikkal
commentary: that's two in two! Back of a length on leg, so Padikkal goes low to ramp it over third man. However, it's a slower ball, the bounce doesn't rise as he expected, and has mistimed the shot. Doesn't go over Rayudu, who takes the catch inside the circle. Padikkal falls after a 50-ball innings at a strike-rate of 140.

name: AB de Villiers
commentary: sliced and Shardul gets the big wicket. Length ball, wider outside off. de Villiers backed away to the leg side so that he could go inside out over cover. But it was wider than he expected, mistimes the shot, and Raina takes the skyer at cover

name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: full on leg stump. Misses the yorker, and Maxwell looks to smack a six over cow corner. But he checks the shot instead of offering a full flourish. Taken by the outfielder rather comfortably

name: TH David
commentary: simply sensational! Good length ball on off stump, but its the legcutter. Tries to chip an inside out loft over cover but slices the shot. Raina reverse cups his hands, and takes an easy one

name: HV Patel
commentary: fitting end to the innings as Bravo gets his third. Overpitched outside off. Looks to clatter a six over long off. Slices it, and Raina at cover takes another. RCB finish on 156 for 6

name: PWH de Silva
commentary: No Commentary

name: RD Gaikwad
commentary: that's a super catch from Kohli and he belts out a roar! Faf has asked Gaikwad to wait, and the umpires will go upstairs to check if it was a clean catch. Soft signal is out. And it will stay that way. Yuzi deceives Gaikwad in flight and turn as he attempts a drive, gets a thick edge and Kohli moving to his left from backward point then puts in a full-length dive forward to catch it superbly.

name: F du Plessis
commentary: swept straight to short fine! Are RCB finding their way back? Extra bounce on this length delivery as Faf attempted a sweep. Got it high on the bat. Saini in taking the catch may have hurt his finger.

name: MM Ali
commentary: Patel adds to his tally as the slower ball gets him a wicket. Full on his toes, Moeen looks to flick it over midwicket. But the 112kph ball gets him to play the shot too early, in the air, and Kohli gets under it at midwicket to take a simple one

name: AT Rayudu
commentary: pulled to midwicket! Another one for Harshal. Length ball outside off, and pulled in front of square. Straight to midwicket!

name: SK Raina
commentary: No Commentary

name: MS Dhoni
commentary: No Commentary

name: RG Sharma
commentary: goes for the heave, but is taken at long-on! Narine gets Rohit yet again - ninth time in T20s. It is a good length ball on off, which gets good bounce. Rohit is down on his back knee early to try and hammer that, but gets it off the higher side of the bat, as the catch is taken right on the edge of the boundary

name: Q de Kock
commentary: mistimed! Slower ball, full just outside off. de Kock picks the slower ball, and then tries to clatter a slog over midwicket. But the bat's face turned while playing the shot, and it's gone straight to Narine at midwicket. Out for 55

name: SA Yadav
commentary: out first ball! Good length just outside off. Surya looks to flick across the line, and ends up getting an edge to DK. Just a bit of away movement after hitting the deck, and that's what messes Surya's attempted flick. Expected the ball would angle in, instead it went the other direction. Surya's dry run continues

name: Ishan Kishan
commentary: skyer and Russell runs in from long on to take a catch around mid on. Short ball, on middle, and Kishan looks to pull. But he toe-ends the shot, and Russell makes no mistake although it went high in the night sky

name: KA Pollard
commentary: Pollard caught napping at the bowler's end! Full and wide ball, Pollard clatters a shot to Morgan at cover. But Morgan picks up in one swift move, and then throws to Ferguson with the bowler near the stumps. Pollard slow off the blocks, and out by a couple of metres

name: KH Pandya
commentary: on a team hat-trick as Lockie makes that two in two. Back of a length ball from around the stumps. Takes the pace off too. Pandya looks to pull by swiveling to the leg side, but that's been mistimed. Iyer at long on gets under it

name: SS Tiwary
commentary: No Commentary

name: AF Milne
commentary: No Commentary

name: Shubman Gill
commentary: bowled 'im! Bumrah hits back! Offcutter from the quick this time, as Gill chops it back on to his stumps. He looks to poke at that tentatively, as it is a full delivery pitching on off, while also coming back in. There is a gap between his bat and pad, and enough space for the ball to crash into his middle stump

name: VR Iyer
commentary: leg stump knocked back and Iyer has been done in by a slower ball. Fullish, outside leg stump but angling into leg. He clears the front leg to muscle a six over midwicket but this time he is done in by the lack of pace. Standing ovation for Iyer from the KKR management

name: RA Tripathi
commentary: No Commentary

name: EJG Morgan
commentary: back of a length, on middle, and he pulls to the leg side. But top-edged, and it goes to Boult fielding in the deep.

name: N Rana
commentary: No Commentary

name: DA Warner
commentary: Warner's horror time in the IPL continues! Back of a length on leg stump. It's angling into Warner, and he looks to work it to square leg off the back foot. But the ball seams away (just that extra bit) at the last moment, takes the leading edge, and pops up for point to get under it.

name: WP Saha
commentary: mistimed pull and taken by Dhawan. Back of a length outside off. Saha tries to drag a pull but the ball rises on him, and he ends up slicing the shot. Dhawan tracks the ball over his shoulders from midwicket, and then does the Thigh Five to celebrate.

name: KS Williamson
commentary: Third time unlucky! Rides the luck, and this time it ends. Not as full as Williamson thought. Comes down the ground but doesn't get to the pitch of the ball. Struck in the air, and Hetmyer at long off runs to his right to take a catch. That's three down

name: MK Pandey
commentary: leading edge, and nabbed by Rabada! Good length ball on middle and seemed to be angling in too, as he tries to clip that away to the on side, but instead balloons it back to the bowler, who takes a few steps to his right to complete an easy take. He is now on a hat-trick too

name: KM Jadhav
commentary: rapped in front, and given leg before! But Jadhav challenges that decision. A good length ball on off, and angling into the batter a little. He goes to flick but misses, as the ball strikes his front pad. No inside edge there. Pitches just outside off and angles in, with replays showing that would have crashed into middle. Sunrisers have now lost half their side with not too many on the board

name: Abdul Samad
commentary: top-edged, and gone! Slower ball on this occasion, and on a short of a length just outside off. Samad pulls, but gets a top edge, as Pant takes a few steps to his left to complete a comfortable catch

name: JO Holder
commentary: down the track, and chipped to cover! Full delivery pitching slightly wide of off, with a hint of turn away from the right-hander. But with Holder already out of his crease, he has a go at that, only to lob it to Shaw at cover. Another blow for Sunrisers

name: Rashid Khan
commentary: run-out at the keeper's end! Good work by the substitute fielder Smith at long-on. Very full ball outside off, and Rashid drags that to long-on with a flat bat. There was some confusion among the batters for once, which means Rashid is late on to the keeper's end, by which time Pant has already whipped off the stumps

name: B Kumar
commentary: No Commentary

name: Sandeep Sharma
commentary: run-out again, as Pant hits this time! He had his right glove off already, as Bhuvneshwar swung to this fullish ball outside off, as the batters took off to try and steal a bye. But Sandeep is far from the crease at the keeper's end, as Pant strikes and finds him short

name: PP Shaw
commentary: sliding catch by the captain! Full outside off. Angling further away. Shaw looks to drag a slog to deep midwicket but ends up dragging it to mid on's right. Williamson runs towards long on, uses his knees to slide along the grass, and completes the catch rather comfortably. Shaw gone for 11.

name: S Dhawan
shorttext: c Abdul Samad b Rashid Khan
commentary: taken at deep square leg! Flatter and quicker on middle, with the ball turning into him off a full length at middle. Dhawan goes down on his back knee to sweep, but mistimes it, and with the longer boundary there, finds the fielder

name: SS Iyer
commentary: No Commentary

name: RR Pant
commentary: No Commentary

name: E Lewis
commentary: sliced to extra cover! Another change of pace ball by Arshdeep. He bowls this pretty full on off, as Lewis looks to go inside out over cover, but mistimes this time. Agarwal goes low right on the edge of the circle to complete the catch. Much-needed breakthrough for Kings

name: YBK Jaiswal
commentary: oh dear, Jaiswal is heartbroken! Out for 49, and maybe pays the price for becoming a bit tentative after getting close to 50. Full ball on middle. Looks to work it to midwicket, but the ball angles away, takes a leading edge, and Mayank at short cover dives forward to dismiss Jaiswal. This will disappoint Jaiswal immensely, but his anchoring innings has given Royals the base for a slog-overs assault from here on

name: SV Samson
commentary: nabbed by Rahul one-handed! Samson goes for the slash to this good length ball slightly wide of off, and gets a top edge. The ball flies off his bat, as Rahul hangs out his right glove while leaping after the ball comes to him a touch higher too. Very good catch to send back his counterpart

name: LS Livingstone
commentary: that's what Allen can do! And Arshdeep gives Livingstone a flying kiss. Short of good length, and Livingstone aims for that cow-corner six again. Struck well, but that's irrelevant when the flying Fabian Allen is in that region. Runs to his right from deep midwicket, then dives to his right, and the ball sticks in his hands despite a hard fall! Livingstone out after a cameo. Big wicket for the Kings to get in the 12th over

name: MK Lomror
commentary: full on the fifth-stump line. Lomror looks to hit a six over long on, but the timing off the bat is not perfect. Markram at long on with a simple catch. But what a momentum-making innings this has been from Lomror! Was brutal on Hooda.

name: R Parag
commentary: holes pout at long on! And Parag will be disappointed on missing out. Full just outside off stump, and he goes for the big one over Shami's head. Struck a bit more towards the on side, and that brings long on into play. Runs to his left, gobbles a catch

name: R Tewatia
commentary: beautiful! Gets the pace up, goes for the yorker, and successfully delivered at the base of leg. Tewatia looks to protect his toes, and in the process is late to bring the bat down. Stumps knocked back

name: CH Morris
commentary: South African caught by South African This was in the slot, to be fair. Full just outside off, but Morris ends up slicing a lofted shot. Too high off the bat, has the height as it goes into the night sky, but the distance is missing. Second wicket for Shami in the over.

name: C Sakariya
commentary: that's four for Arshdeep as he gets under the catch himself. His best IPL figures too! Slower ball, back of a length. Sakariya looks to pull, but sliced up in the air. Arshdeep runs forward, settles under it, stretches forward and takes the catch

name: Kartik Tyagi
commentary: what did I tell you at the start of the over? Of course Arshdeep can! Yorker on off. He backs away to drive through cover. But the ball goes under the bat and breaks off stump. Smile for Arshdeep as he takes his five-wicket haul and Rajasthan Royals are all out for 185

name: Mustafizur Rahman
commentary: No Commentary

name: KL Rahul
commentary: another one out on 49! Jaiswal a few hours ago, Rahul now. Good length ball angling across. Tries to cut through point but the slower ball gets a thicker edge. Straight to Tyagi at short third man

name: MA Agarwal
commentary: tossed up, full outside off. Goes for the inside out drive over cover, but sliced it instead. In the air, flies to deep point, and Livingstone isn't dropping those! There's the second opener gone, Agarwal out for 67

name: AK Markram
commentary: No Commentary

name: N Pooran
commentary: guided....to the keeper! Overpitched just outside off. Pooran opens the bat's face to run it down to third man. But all he has done is poked it straight to Samson. Kings need 3 off 3. And it's a new batter facing the next delivery.

name: DJ Hooda
commentary: make that three in 1! Tyagi takes another wicket. Full and wide outside off stump. Looks to drive away from his body, and it takes an edge to Samson. The new batter will face the last ball.

name: FA Allen
commentary: No Commentary

name: V Kohli
commentary: rapped in front, and given! Prasidh hits back right away. But Kohli reviews. The ball was fullish on middle, and was darting back in as Kohli went to flick that toward square leg and missed. No inside edge is confirmed by UltraEdge. Looks like it would be clipping leg stump, with a possible chance of umpire's call there. There is a bit of wait for ball tracking though... But it is three reds, and replays confirm that would have hit the top of leg. What a vital breakthrough so early for Knight Riders

name: D Padikkal
commentary: taken behind by Karthik, and Knight Riders wrap up the powerplay with a wicket! Padikkal looks to ramp that good length ball on middle toward third man, but the ball is too close to his body to play that shot, since he has to sway out of the way and go low too. There is a thick outside edge there, and Ferguson has his man

name: KS Bharat
commentary: pulled to deep square leg, and a good catch by Gill running to his right! Goes for the pull to this short ball on off, with the ball almost rushing on to him. He was nearly off balance too while playing that, and seemed to have got that from the higher side of the bat too. Not a great innings by Bharat, considering he was in early and during the powerplay

name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: bowled him with a superb delivery! Flicks his fingers over the ball, tosses it up, gets it to drift in and skid through on middle, Maxwell went for an ugly mow but was through with it early, the ball sneaked through to crash into the stumps.

name: AB de Villiers
commentary: bowled him first ball! A crashing yorker has de Villiers for a golden duck! Very full ball on middle and leg, which is also shaping to come into the batter. de Villiers' front leg is on leg stump, as the ball strikes that to ricochet behind to the stumps. What a blow for the Royal Challengers

name: Sachin Baby
commentary: deceived and gone! He slices this straight to backward point. Baby doesn't pick the wrong'un as he looks to swing into the leg side, the easy catch popped to Nitish Rana.

name: PWH de Silva
commentary: big shout for lbw, given! Wanindu completely misreads that and plays for the turn away, but this one pitches on middle and skids through to crash into the pad. As an umpire, Nigel Llong couldn't have asked for an easier decision to make.

name: KA Jamieson
commentary: looks like Jamieson is gone! Varun may have got a feather of a finger in trying to stop that hard drive down the ground. Yes, replays confirm that. Jamieson was off the field even before 'OUT' flashed on the screen.

name: HV Patel
commentary: right into the blockhole, 'you miss, I hit' stuff. Harshal exposed all three stumps in trying to scythe that behind point. It was the slower yorker. Lovely delivery.

name: Mohammed Siraj
commentary: this time he gets bat to ball in trying to scoop that but guess what? He's picked out fine leg. Ah, he didn't even have to move an inch.

name: YS Chahal
commentary: No Commentary

name: Shubman Gill
commentary: he's holed out to long-off. Gill lives by the sword, dies by it. Looking to step out and launch Yuzi down into Sheikh Zayed Road, but doesn't time it well. Ends up slicing this to Siraj.

name: VR Iyer
commentary: No Commentary

name: AD Russell
commentary: No Commentary

name: RD Gaikwad
commentary: No Commentary

name: F du Plessis
commentary: got him! Faf has a go at this because he has a hint of width, but he ends up slicing it straight to short third man. Boult roar, Mumbai strike early.

name: MM Ali
commentary: he has toe-ended this attempted slap straight to cover point! Milne goes short of length, Moeen has width to work with but has no timing. Tiwary takes a good catch diving low to his right. Super Kings rocked early

name: AT Rayudu
commentary: Rayudu is on the floor! This one was banged in short, he thought it'll comfortably pass over but it nipped back in, kept low and smacked his elbow. Rayudu is in serious pain. The left elbow has swollen and the physio is out with his magic spray.

name: SK Raina
commentary: got him! Raina was never comfortable! This was full and swinging away, Raina backed away anticipating the short ball, threw his bat at that only for it to break into two pieces, the slice lobbed straight to point. Raina wouldn't want to look at this innings, ever. A good chunk of wood came off as Raina swung at that.

name: MS Dhoni
commentary: he's hit this beautifully but has picked out the lone man at deep square! It came to Boult faster than he expected but he manages to hang on. Dhoni walks off in disbelief! This was short, Dhoni swiveled nice and early and picked the bones out of this pull.

name: RA Jadeja
commentary: around the stumps. Full ball outside off. Jadeja clears the front leg and tries to hit a big shot over Bumrah's head but he's sliced it since Bumrah had taken the pace off. Pollard at long off gets under it, and pockets a catch with ease. An important 26 from Jadeja given the innings' situation when he walked in

name: DJ Bravo
commentary: holes out. But Bravo has played an excellent cameo. Bumrah goes for the length ball that angles in from wide of the crease. Bravo can't make room, looks to loft it over cover, but slices it to the fielder inside the circle

name: SN Thakur
commentary: No Commentary

name: Q de Kock
commentary: big appeal for lbw, massive appeal infact. Not given by Illingworth but MSD reviews immediately. Looks very close, I think he's in trouble. This is bowled full on middle and off, the ball bends back in a touch to beat the inside edge as well as he tries to work it through the leg side. Ball tracking comes back to show this would've crashed into the stumps. Chahar knew it straightaway, he didn't even bother turning back until he passed de Kock.

name: Anmolpreet Singh
commentary: bowled him with a slower ball! Anmol looks to mow this leg side but is deceived by the knuckleball, early into the stroke and the off-stump goes for a toss. Chahar roars, Chennai Super Kings fan roar.

name: SA Yadav
commentary: no timing and he's gone! Shardul gets into the thick of things, it's that man Faf with a top catch. Looks to loft him down the ground on the up but the ball stops on him and goes off the bottom part of the bat, Faf running back and across from mid-off takes a superb catch.

name: Ishan Kishan
commentary: he's picked out cover where Raina makes no mistake! Bravo once again goes full and just outside Kishan's reach, this is a slower one, mind you, so he has to force the pace. Kishan tries to go over the infield but fails to do so and Chennai have a massive wicket.

name: SS Tiwary
commentary: No Commentary

name: KA Pollard
commentary: trapped first ball! And Hazlewood gets Pollard with a full ball that skids in while staying low. Full on off, zipping in, hits him low on the back leg with the bat too slow to get down. Pollard reviews, which is of course his right, but this looks plumb. Ball-tracking confirms that's crashing into middle stump. Big wicket, Hazlewood makes a strong return in his second spell.

name: KH Pandya
commentary: length ball on middle, and clipped to midwicket. Krunal wants one right away, but there was no run there. Bravo picks up and throws it to Dhoni while Krunal looks to turn and get back. Too slow to do that, Dhoni is standing right on top of the stumps, and the bails have been whipped off in a flash. They've gone upstairs for confirmation but Pandya isn't waiting. He's on his way out!

name: AF Milne
commentary: boundary rider at deep midwicket takes a simple one. Fullish, outside off and angling in. Milne swings the bat and it's got a decent connection. But Gowtham is a tall man on the boundary line, and pockets that comfortably

name: RD Chahar
commentary: slower ball, full outside off stump. Chahar goes deep before bringing out the slog sweep. Struck well, but straight to the safe Raina at short midwicket!

name: JJ Bumrah
commentary: No Commentary

name: Prabhsimran Singh
commentary: jogs to the left and holds on at mid-off. Smith. Full and just outside off stump. Clears the front and looks to drill that wide of the fielder. It ends up a friendly slice and Smith takes it easily, about chest height, with palms facing each other like he's an evil character casting a spell

name: MA Agarwal
commentary: No Commentary

name: CH Gayle
commentary: stumps flying!This is a 144kph full toss, dipping away from middle stump. Gayle is startled by that and hurriedly pushes at this. In panic, almost. Completely misses that and off stump goes cartwheeling as he hits the top of it. Probably an attempted yorker gone wrong, but full and fast has done it

name: DJ Malan
commentary: knocks leg stump. Lovely bowling. Slows it right down, lands it a length on middle and leg. Turns it in marginally and draws an early hoick from Malan. Completes his stroke and there's a delay before the ball hits the leg stump

name: DJ Hooda
commentary: mix-up and we're going upstairs to see who is out. Looks like a run-out at both ends to me at first. It's a length ball at off stump, Agarwal drives to extra cover's right and takes off. Hooda doesn't want the run. Hetmyer lunges to his right and quickly flicks it back in at the non-striker's end. Hooda and Agarwal are both headed for that end when Axar receives the throw and takes the bails off. The batsmen hadn't crossed on the pitch, because Hooda was always running backwards. And he is short of the crease when Axar completes the run-out. So he's the one who will be dismissed. Mayank arrives in frame later. He's safe. Axar also throws it to the other end, to Pant, for good measure. Hooda would've survived if he had looked to sacrifice his wicket, ironically

name: M Shahrukh Khan
commentary: taken at extra cover by Hetmyer pedaling backwards. It's overpitched but it's fast. Shahrukh wants to hit this straight but is not in position at all, still into his shuffle, as he attempts it. Sliced and not far past the circle

name: CJ Jordan
commentary: short and tucked him up at leg stump. He can't get a swing away on the pull, ends up stabbing at it and gets a top edge that floats out to deep square

name: Harpreet Brar
commentary: No Commentary

name: PP Shaw
commentary: the magician is back and doing his thing! What a delivery. Length ball, drifting in at middle stump, drawing him into the drive and turning it past him to hit the top of off stump. What a life this is - Kohli, Maxwell, AB, Shaw his first four IPL wickets

name: S Dhawan
commentary: No Commentary

name: SPD Smith
commentary: chipped straight to deep square. Smith's made a habit of playing surprising shots in the IPL when they aren't required. This is one of them. Length and into off stump. Walks into the off side and wants to whip this behind square on the leg. That sticks slightly in the pitch and he ends up getting too far under it. Lofted right up and Malan takes an easy one

name: RR Pant
commentary: bat flies into the leg side, ball into the off side. Pant headed to the dugout. It's a length ball at the stumps, he wants to muscle this over the leg side and loses his shape. Loses his bat too. It floats up for Agarwal at extra cover, an easy slice to catch

name: SO Hetmyer
commentary: No Commentary

name: JC Buttler
commentary: fullish and outside off, Buttler has a slog at it and plays it on. No celebrations from Sandeep or Bairstow. Parag punches Butter's gloves and sends him off. Top innings from a top white-ball batter

name: YBK Jaiswal
commentary: this is much closer, and umpire Gaffney raises his finger. Jasiwal has a chat with Buttler and walks off. Slider from Rashid, fizzes in to ping the pad bang in front of middle. Jaiswal is beaten for both length and pace. He plays back to it and doesn't put bat on ball once again

name: SV Samson
commentary: Samad shows his team-mates how to take the pressure catches. He snags it at the edge of the long-off boundary. Good overhead catch. Fullish and wide of off. Vijay takes it away from Samson's swinging arc. The batter looks to pump it through the line, but can only slice it off the bottom part

name: R Parag
commentary: No Commentary

name: DA Miller
commentary: No Commentary

name: MK Pandey
commentary: bowled 'im! Was a slower one from Mustafizur. On the fuller side around middle and leg, Pandey went for the flick but ended up playing early. The ball hit the pads before disturbing the stumps

name: JM Bairstow
commentary: Caught by debutant Anuj Rawat at long-on. Slower legbreak from Tewatia, spins away from Bairstow. Flat and shapes away from the batter, who gets into a sweeping position and ends up dragging the ball to Rawat who is a keeper at Delhi

name: KS Williamson
commentary: Holes out to Morris at deep midwicket. First wicket for Tyagi in IPL 2021 and he has taken out Williamson. Slower short ball into the pitch and the line is outside off. The pull was on, but Williamson hits it straight to the outfielder

name: V Shankar
commentary: Miller runs in from long-on and takes this skier. Banged into the pitch and outside off, offcutter from Morris. Vijay rocks into a back-foot pull and splices it to another South African - Miller

name: KM Jadhav
commentary: Jadhav plays back and is castled. On-pace full ball, nips into middle. Jadhav slogs and misses. Morris hits the middle stump

name: Mohammad Nabi
shorttext: c Anuj Rawat b Mustafizur Rahman
commentary: offcutter at 119.2ks outside off, sliced straight to extra-cover. Whippy change-up from Mustafizur, Nabi looks to loft down the ground. Instead, he miscues it to Rawat again

name: Abdul Samad
commentary: Rawat runs back and holds onto his third catch even as the ball swirls away from his reach. He runs back from extra-cover and takes it over his shoulder before diving into the ground. Slower cutter outside off, Samad can only sky it to the debutant

name: Rashid Khan
commentary: Mustafizur rolls out another offcutter. He now has Rashid holing out to long-off.  It was too full, but the lack of pace does Rashid in. He slogs and slices it to Morris

name: B Kumar
commentary: No Commentary

name: Sandeep Sharma
commentary: No Commentary

name: RD Gaikwad
commentary: leading-edged to Hardik at point. Fuller side of a good length on middle, no real movement in the air or off the seam. Gaikwad aims leg side, but closes the bat-face a touch early and spoons a catch to the infielder

name: F du Plessis
commentary: Golden arm: Pollard. Fine leg is inside the circle, so Faf goes for the ramp, but picks out Bumrah. Faf shuffles across off even before Pollard delivers this offcutter. The lack of pace does Faf in. He miscues it in the air. Bumrah lunges forward, snatches at the ball, and just about hangs onto it

name: MM Ali
commentary: Bumrah comes back and takes out Moeen! Dug in short, slanting into Moeen from around the wicket, cramping Moeen. The batter aims to lean back and ramp it over de Kock. It's quick and close to his body, so he can only guide it into the gloves of the keeper

name: SK Raina
commentary: Pollard wheels away in celebration. Catch him if you can. 107ks cutter outside off. Raina aims to manufacture some pace of his own, but does not middle this. Heaved to Krunal at deep midwicket. Raina holes out for 2 in his 200th IPL match

name: AT Rayudu
commentary: No Commentary

name: RA Jadeja
commentary: No Commentary

name: Q de Kock
commentary: Spooned back to Moeen. Make that three wickets in three overs for CSK. Nicely bowled, dipping into a fuller length on middle, de Kock closes the bat-face early and chips a leading-edge back to Moeen

name: RG Sharma
commentary: Thakur strikes in his first over to have Rohit holing out to Gaikwad at sweeper cover. Slightly back of a length and around off stump, Rohit aims to pump it over extra-cover. Instead, he slices it squarer to Gaikwad

name: SA Yadav
commentary: Two in two overs for CSK. Jadeja has Surya nicking off this time. Pushed through on a length, 99ks and spins away just enough outside off. Surya chucks his hands at the ball and nicks it behind to Dhoni who snags a low catch

name: KH Pandya
commentary: Curran: makes things happen. Into the blockhole from wide of the crease, plunges at Krunal and pings the boot bang in front. Great execution under pressure from Curran

name: KA Pollard
commentary: No Commentary

name: HH Pandya
commentary: Faf slides to his right from wide long-off and holds onto this catch. Is this game still on? Curran errs with his length once again. He offers up a slot ball outside off, Hardik aims for a lofted drive, but only slices it in the air

name: JDS Neesham
commentary: Lapped straight to Thakur running to his left from deep square leg. Low full-toss on middle, fine leg is inside the circle, so Neesham looks to scoop it over that infielder. Instead, he hits it squarer to Thakur

name: DS Kulkarni
commentary: No Commentary

name: KL Rahul
commentary: No Commentary

name: Prabhsimran Singh
commentary: taken easily at extra cover. Short of a length outside off, backs into the leg side to try and make room. Looked initially like he wanted to chop that over the off side, but on close inspection it's a pull shot gone wrong. Gets big on him and he ends up slicing it

name: CH Gayle
commentary: he's got him and he's delighted! Sams with a sharp, steep bouncer from a middle stump line. Slanted in at the front shoulder and he's surprised and looks to swish this, out of position and eyes off. Gets a glove and AB takes that to his right

name: N Pooran
commentary: fended straight to backward point and another duck for Pooran! Fourth of the season. Short ball into off stump. He wants to ride the bounce and get that to third man but he's opened the face too soon and it's popped up for an easy catch

name: DJ Hooda
commentary: miscued pull and taken at deep backward square! Short of a length and pushed through quicker at leg stump. Wants to send this over square leg, but has gotten under it and hauled it upwards. It's the long side of the ground too. Taken easily

name: M Shahrukh Khan
commentary: another googly and this time it meets off stump! Short of a length just outside off, looks to cut that. Caught on the front foot, big gap between bat and leg.

name: Harpreet Brar
commentary: No Commentary

name: V Kohli
commentary: that stays low and slides into leg stump. Short of a length at middle stump, he steps out and looks to turn that through midwicket. That slides on low and is past him. He looks at the pitch in surprise, Harpreet has the most subdued celebration with his arm raised. What a wicket to get

name: D Padikkal
commentary: makes a mockery of off stump! What. A. Sight. Length and fired in at an off stump line, 145.7kph. Padikkal backs into the leg side as he steps out, exposes the stumps and looks to slam the over the infield. It's wayyy too quick for that. Off stump is sent a long way into the leg side, in fine leg's direction

name: RM Patidar
commentary: holes out to long-on and Patidar's innings ends just as inelegantly as it has looked all evening. Full and into middle stump, clears the front leg and looks to slog. His top hand slips off the handle, his body's facing midwicket, his bat held high in the right hand. Not a great night for him. Pooran comes in from the boundary and holds on

name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: oh Harpreet you ripper! I think he's spun it from middle, beaten Maxwell's whip into the leg side and hit the top of off. For some reason they're sending that upstairs...yeah it's dead-on. He's squared him up to hit the top of off. Maxwell didn't know what happened. Neither did the umpires, it appears. But the evidence is there - Harpreet has pitched this at a length on middle stump and turned it past Maxwell to clean him up

name: AB de Villiers
commentary: he's got AB too! This is a fairytale for Harpreet. Short of a length and pushed through at off stump, sticks in the pitch. AB clears the front leg and looks to punch it on the rise through the covers. Ends up chipping it straight to Rahul at extra cover

name: Shahbaz Ahmed
shorttext: c Harpreet Brar b Ravi Bishnoi
commentary: taken at deep midwicket! Harpreet is there too. Length ball sliding across the corridor, fetches it with a slog sweep but is taken comfortably inside the line

name: DR Sams
commentary: googly, short of a length outside off and spinning into middle. Looks to swipe over that, angled bat, and the stumps are split

name: KA Jamieson
commentary: No Commentary

name: HV Patel
shorttext: c Ravi Bishnoi b Mohammed Shami
commentary: Bishnoi's taken another stunner! Wow! He's really enjoying fielding in the deep this season! Low full toss at off stump, backs away and lofts this to long-off's right. Bishnoi tracks it and then lunges forward and to his right to grab this very close to the turf

name: Mohammed Siraj
commentary: No Commentary

name: N Rana
commentary: Rana runs past the slider, Pant grabs the ball, and flips the bails off. Axar pulls his length back, gets it to angle away from the advancing batsman from wide of the crease, from left-arm around. Rana chucks his hands at the ball and misses. Pant does the rest behind the stumps

name: Shubman Gill
commentary: 121ks slower offcutter on off stump, Gill looks to break free. He lofts it in the air, but can't manufacture his own pace, and holes out to Smith at long-on. Bouncer, yorker, slower variation - Avesh is showing his range

name: RA Tripathi
commentary: carved straight in the air to Lalit at deep cover. Good length and pushed wide of Tripathi once again. He uses his feet, opens the bat-face, and picks out Lalit in the outfield

name: EJG Morgan
commentary: holes out to long-off. Smith runs across to his right, judges it well, and sends back Morgan. The KKR captain backs away outside leg, Lalit darts it into middle and leg from round the wicket. Morgan aims for the loft, doesn't get enough power behind it, and Smith makes that tumbling take look pretty easy

name: SP Narine
commentary: Narine has been castled for a duck. Quick offbreak from Lalit. Angling in from round the wicket, on a fullish length, Lalit finds just enough turn to beat the outside edge and hit off stump. Narine drives on the up and misses it altogether

name: AD Russell
commentary: No Commentary

name: KD Karthik
commentary: Karthik does not connect with a reverse-sweep and has been given out leg before by umpire Barde. Karthik has a chat with Russell and calls for a review. Axar drags his length back, thumps the back pad above the knee-roll in front of middle. No bat involved. Ball-tracking suggests it would've cannoned into middle. Three reds, so Karthik has to exit

name: PJ Cummins
commentary: No Commentary

name: PP Shaw
commentary: Top-edged in the air and taken at point. Shaw shuffles outside leg, manufactures swinging room, but Cummins bangs a lifter that follows the moving batsman. Spliced in the air. It swerves away from Rana, but he gets into a side-on position and hangs onto this skier. Shaw is warmly welcomed back by his team-mates and Ponting

name: S Dhawan
commentary: Dhawan misses a low full-toss sliding into him from round the wicket. Trapped bang in front. Dhawan shuffles across off and doesn't connect with a flick. It would've crashed into the middle of middle stump. Some respite for KKR and their fans

name: RR Pant
commentary: <s>Pant finishes it off with a six</s>. Holes out to Mavi at the long-on boundary. On a length and outside off, it was in Pant's slot. He lofts, but can't clear the outfielder

name: MP Stoinis
commentary: No Commentary

name: SO Hetmyer
commentary: No Commentary

name: JC Buttler
commentary: beats him in flight! Lovely follow-up from Chahar. Buttler steps out early and is met with a beautiful dipping, drifting delivery. It must have appeared to be in his arc briefly, but by the time he gets a shot away, it has already landed and spins past him. He was looking to go over long-on

name: YBK Jaiswal
commentary: leading edge taken. Full loopy googly at leg stump, Jaiswal gets low and forward, closes the face too early on the flick and it is a simple catch for a visibly frustrated Chahar

name: SV Samson
commentary: knocks out middle stump! Mumbai really nailing these yorkers right now. Samson clears the front leg and looks to whip that, but looks like it's got a tiny deflection into the stumps

name: S Dube
commentary: Bumrah takes an easy one. Low full toss and very tight at his legs, looks to whip over midwicket, comes off the high part of the bat and floats harmlessly over the pitch

name: DA Miller
commentary: No Commentary

name: R Parag
commentary: No Commentary

name: RG Sharma
commentary: chipped straight to mid-on! That is soft. It's an overpitched ball at leg stump, he's caught halfway between trying to lift this on-drive and hitting it wide of the fielder. Ends up giving him a comfortably grab at waist height

name: Q de Kock
commentary: No Commentary

name: SA Yadav
commentary: flicked straight to midwicket! A dipping slower ball at middle stump, wants to loft that over the man but he can't find the elevation. Morris produces a wicket once again

name: KH Pandya
commentary: inside edge onto middle stump! He's looked fidgety whenever the ball curves in at the stumps, and once again he's caught in an awkward position. Too close to try and crash it through the covers. But this has been an important innings for him, and for Mumbai, kept the pressure on Rajasthan after SKY's wicket

name: KA Pollard
commentary: No Commentary

name: DA Warner
commentary: Ngidi puts Warner out his misery. A tortured stay comes to an end. Ngidi aims for the wide yorker, comes out as a very full ball wide of off. Warner reaches out for the ball, loses his shape, and weakly carves it to Jadeja at sweeper cover. He holes out for 57 off 55

name: JM Bairstow
commentary: Bairstow was itching to dash out of the crease against the seamers. Curran pushes him back with a quicker short ball. Bairstow can't quite control the pull. He splices it in the air. Chahar runs across to his left from square-ish long leg and snaffles it

name: MK Pandey
commentary: Incredible effort from du Plessis at wide long-on. He gives his team-mates a thumbs up. This one seems destined to sail over the boundary....until Faf dives to his right and plucks it out of thin air with both hands. He makes it look ridiculously easy. Even Jadeja loved it. Pitched up and outside off, as Ngidi misses his yorker, hauled away

name: KS Williamson
commentary: No Commentary

name: KM Jadhav
commentary: No Commentary

name: RD Gaikwad
commentary: Rashid strikes back to knock over the off stump. Nevertheless, this is a fine knock from Gaikwad. Gaikwad plays for the googly/slider that would come into him, but this is the legbreak that turns away just enough to beat the outside edge and hit the off stump. Finally, some respite for SRH

name: F du Plessis
commentary: Rashid strikes again. Another googly, this time to the right-hander, fizzes in and pings the front pad as Faf plays for the legbreak and misses. He goes for a review. Ultra Edge confirms no bat involved. The tracker returns umpire's call on leg stump. Faf has to go

name: MM Ali
commentary: holes out to wide long-on. Rashid takes this wrong'un away from Moeen's swinging arc. He still goes for the slog and finds Jadhav

name: RA Jadeja
commentary: No Commentary

name: SK Raina
commentary: No Commentary

name: V Kohli
commentary: chops it on and off stump is out of the ground! I can hear shouting again, this time from the bowler. Short of a length and jagging into the corridor, width getting tighter and tighter off the surface as Kohli shapes to play the late cut again

name: D Padikkal
commentary: cuts through him and hits the top of off! This is a proper Test match stock delivery from Ishant, length and slanted across middle but holding its line, met with a closed face as Devdutt looks to get this into the midwicket region. He's left a bit of a gap between bat and pad and has been beaten by pace

name: RM Patidar
commentary: pulls straight to long-on! He can't believe that. It's short of a length and into him, there for a pretty vicious pull. But it is flat and to Smith's right, and he tracks it nicely to hold on to a sharp one

name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: dragged straight to long-on! Trademark Mishra wicket this. It is despairingly slow and loopy outside off, turning away. Maxwell's eyes light up and he looks to club this against the turn. It's come off the toe-end and that is now five times he's fallen to Mishra

name: AB de Villiers
commentary: No Commentary

name: Washington Sundar
commentary: taken pitch-side. Short ball, cramping him at the chest. He wants to pull that away, he's not in shape, perhaps not even looking it at it by the end. The bat turns in his hands, one of them comes off, and it hangs nicely for Rabada. Sundar's batting form continues to desert him

name: DR Sams
commentary: No Commentary

name: PP Shaw
commentary: short and wide outside off, he chases it and there's a faint sound on that! And Shaw walks off. That was wide - literally, past the tramline. He wants to slash that behind point and has got a thin outside edge

name: S Dhawan
commentary: he's steered it straight to fine leg! That's a little tame, but it's a plan that's worked for Jamieson. Clear plan to cramp Dhawan this over. This time he follows him down leg side, gets it up at the hips. He wants to use the pace and get that over the fielder but he picks him out

name: SPD Smith
commentary: straightens that and draws the edge! Lovely delivery. Length and angled into the corridor, but straightening off the pitch. A cross seam delivery. Smith looks to drive on the rise and gets a big edge through to AB

name: RR Pant
commentary: No Commentary

name: MP Stoinis
commentary: screeches in delight after drawing the edge! Good length and wide outside off, Stoinis chucks his hands at that and gets it off the outside edge. A straightforward catch for AB and Harshal is not hiding his joy

name: SO Hetmyer
commentary: No Commentary

name: KL Rahul
commentary: doesn't middle this enough either and he's skied it to mid-off. Made room again for the length ball, lofted it down the ground with a big drive but it wasn't off the middle and Narine had enough time to get under it near the edge of the circle

name: MA Agarwal
commentary: tumbles over but that's a great catch from Tripathi at deep midwicket! And it's the big wicket of Agarwal. Short ball again, Agarwal pulled it off the middle but there's a fielder there who runs in a few yards quickly and gets both his hands under the ball in front of him, and then rolls over to complete it

name: CH Gayle
commentary: big appeal for caught behind on Gayle's first ball! The umpire doesn't move, Karthik is confident there's an edge and reviews even as Gayle's eyes are stuck on the umpire. UltraEdge shows there's a spike when the ball passes the bottom of the bat as Gayle drives away from the body without footwork, it's a first ball duck for Gayle!

name: DJ Hooda
commentary: taken at backward point, sharp catch from captain Morgan. Hooda plays on the up and away from the body for this back of length ball well outside off, the seam was pointing towards third man, and he wasn't in control at all while reaching out so far out. Thick edge flew to Morgan who got his hands under the ball in front of him just in time

name: N Pooran
commentary: swing and a miss, Pooran loses his off stump! Varun takes off in celebration, Karthik shrieks behind the stumps as Pooran pulls with a big heave but he misses this legbreak completely. Short ball on off, just a bit of turn to retain its line and the ball sneaks under the mighty bat of Pooran

name: MC Henriques
commentary: bowled'm through the gate! An offbreak from Narine, no mystery there, and it pitches on the perfect length just outside off to bring Henriques forward but he leaves a big gap between bat and pad, and the ball turns in to sneak through and rattle the stumps

name: M Shahrukh Khan
commentary: connects with the pull this time, but not in control at all and Morgan comes under it at extra cover to pouch it easily. Another big wicket falls for Punjab Kings. Prasidh persisted with the short length, it was a slow cutter, Shahrukh went for his pull and he only managed a top edge which skied the ball

name: CJ Jordan
commentary: deceives him with the slower ball and hits off stump! Prasidh has the last laugh in this last over battle as he lands a length ball at 103kmh on off, Jordan swings again, as expected, but misses it this time

name: Ravi Bishnoi
commentary: flick to leg turns into a leading edge high on the off side and taken easily. Cummins angled the short ball into Bishnoi who was way too early to close the face of the bat in front of the stumps, the ball takes the thick outside edge and hangs in the air on the off side before falling in Morgan's hands at cover

name: Mohammed Shami
commentary: No Commentary

name: Arshdeep Singh
commentary: No Commentary

name: Shubman Gill
commentary: struck right in front, Shami knows it's out, umpire gives it immediately and Gill is walking, no point reviewing that. This one also pitched on length in front of off but didn't go straight like the previous ball, it nipped in, beat the batter who went for a cross-batted shot and was plumb

name: N Rana
commentary: full toss chipped to cover! I've not seen a softer dismissal this IPL, and Rana is really disappointed with himself. Innocuous full toss well outside off, Rana merely chips it in the air and Shahrukh dives to his right to grab it with both hands and that's a duck for Rana

name: RA Tripathi
commentary: Tripathi finds Shahrukh at long-on, the bowling change has worked! Tripathi charged down lofted the length ball down but didn't get the distance, and Shahrukh went to his left to grab that along with a tumble

name: SP Narine
shorttext: c Ravi Bishnoi b Arshdeep Singh
commentary: that's the greatest catch of this IPL already, Ravi Bishnoi has taken a stunner and is running away with the ball, someone stop him! Narine would have finally thought he's connected with a heave, and he did off that back of length ball, but it also went pretty high on the leg side, and Bishnoi ran and ran to his right from deep midwicket and put in a sliding dive at just the right time to pluck the ball a split-second before it could touch the ground. He can't believe it himself he's taken it

name: EJG Morgan
commentary: No Commentary

name: AD Russell
commentary: has Russell made it? The umpire just wants to check if the ball has struck the stumps and not Rahul's gloves without the ball, and Russell is run-out! Morgan cut the googly to short third man and they took off for a single, Russells knees are not the fittest in the world but he responded for a single, stretched to try and make it, but the sharp throw from Arshdeep hit the base of the stumps and found him short

name: KD Karthik
commentary: No Commentary

name: PP Shaw
commentary: Bairstow misses a stumping chance. But Shaw is run-out in the end at Suchith's end. The bowler has collected the ball cleanly to take the bails off. The TV umpire confirms that Shaw is short of his crease. Pant runs past a slider, the ball pops out of Baistow's gloves. Khaheel swoops down on the ball from short fine leg and flings a throw to Suchith to capitalise on a mix-up. There wasn't a run there. Shaw pays the price for his misjudgement. That Pant was ball-watching didn't help his cause either

name: S Dhawan
commentary: Dhawan steps out and misses the line. Rashid hikes his pace to 96ks, slips in the slider, well away from the reach of Dhawan's big swipe. Darts past the pad to hit top of leg stump. Rashid, as he often does, gives SRH a much-needed breakthrough

name: RR Pant
commentary: Holes out to deep midwicket. Simple catch for Suchith in the outfield. Kaul bangs a cutter into the pitch, takes it away from Pant's swinging arc. He fetches it from outside off and drags it to Suchith. It's the smaller side of the ground, but Pant can't clear it this time

name: SPD Smith
commentary: No Commentary

name: SO Hetmyer
commentary: Williamson runs in from long-off and takes this skier. Cool as...Pitched up and outside off, in the slot, but the lack of pace does Hetmyer in. He slices it to Williamson and falls for 1 off 2 balls

name: MP Stoinis
commentary: No Commentary

name: DA Warner
commentary: Has Warner been run-out? Yep, he has a wry smile on his face and walks off even before the TV umpire rules it out. Bairstow jabs it to the left of cover-point and they push across for a very risky single. Rabada swoops down on the ball, flings it to Pant, and catches the SRH captain short

name: JM Bairstow
commentary: Bairstow aims for another six, but holes out to Dhawan. Bairstow shuffles across off once again, this is a seam-up length ball closer to off. Bairstow doesn't have enough room to free his hands. He still dares to hit over the top, but picks out Dhawan at mid-on

name: KS Williamson
commentary: No Commentary

name: Virat Singh
commentary: Virat can't clear Stoinis at midwicket. Back of a length and angling away from outside off, from over the wicket. Virat can't get on top of the bounce. He miscues a pull to the infielder. He falls for an utterly sluggish 4 off 12 balls

name: KM Jadhav
commentary: Jadhav steps out at Mishra. The legspinner slows it up, shortens his length and gets it to break away outside off. Pant collects the ball and takes the bails off. SRH continue to slide around Williamson

name: Abhishek Sharma
commentary: Abhishek has been given out lbw, he chats with Williamson and calls for a review. Full from Axar, spinning into Abhishek to beat the inner edge and ping the front pad on the knee-roll in line with middle. Ultra Edge confirms that there's no bat involved here. The tracker returns three reads and umpire Ananthapadmanabhan's on-field out decision has been vindicated

name: Rashid Khan
commentary: This looks adjacent, too, as Axar wins another lbw appeal from umpire Ananthapadmanabhan. Slider from Axar, fired on middle, Rashid can't connect with the reverse-sweep and is trapped bang in front of middle

name: V Shankar
commentary: Vijay plays on! Slower ball dug into the pitch outside off. Vijay has a roundhouse swipe to the leg side and can only drag it back onto his own stumps

name: J Suchith
commentary: No Commentary

name: RD Gaikwad
commentary: taken at deep square. You'll remember that straight six he hit off Chahal, where he got into sweeping position. Gets in that position again, but this one dips on him faster and he's ended up not getting close to it at middle stump. Has to stretch out, can't possibly go straight from there, and ends up carving it up for the fielder to run in and hold

name: F du Plessis
commentary: taken at long-on! Yet again Harshal is on a hat-trick! Must be the third time this season. Offcutter, short and turning into middle stump. It's an attempted aerial pull, but he can't go through it because that stops on him. Christian runs to the left and takes that smartly. Two new batsmen at the crease suddenly for CSK

name: SK Raina
commentary: dragged out to deep midwicket. Offcutter at a length, at middle stump. Raina jumping down leg side and reaching out this time for the slog. Can't get distance on it and Padikkal takes it comfortably

name: AT Rayudu
commentary: picks out deep square. Offcutter at a length outside off, gets his weight into the off side and looks to swish that over the fine leg boundary. No pace on it, and he's not in the best shape right now either. Can't get enough power on that to clear Jamieson

name: RA Jadeja
commentary: No Commentary

name: MS Dhoni
commentary: No Commentary

name: V Kohli
commentary: superb execution from Curran! Slower ball, dug right into the pitch, short of a length outside off. Kohli looks to cut and that gets big on him. Thick outside edge and an easy take

name: D Padikkal
commentary: taken at backward square! The bowling change has worked out. Thakur slams another in short, tight at Padikkal's body, and that is definitely a vulnerable area for him. Late on the pull and it floats out to Raina

name: Washington Sundar
commentary: taken at deep midwicket. Length at middle stump, a panic-driven jump down the pitch. Nowhere close to meeting that ball. Can only drag it high for Gaikwad

name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: tonks leg stump! Slows it down, slides it on. Maxwell clears the front leg and looks to slog that over deep midwicket. Through it early and misses completely. Jadeja continues to torment RCB

name: AB de Villiers
commentary: no way! Jadeja is like an Under-23 player playing in the Under-11s nets right now. He is managing to embarrass the entirety of RCB, and who bigger than AB de Villiers? He has completely outfoxed him. Length ball, drifted and dipping into leg stump. AB reaches out from the crease and wants to stab that on the front foot. It turns past quickly and hits the top of middle. Stunning, simply stunning performance this

name: DT Christian
commentary: looks like a Jadeja direct hit, and as ever, it looks out. This is just pure bullying from Jadeja and CSK. Once again, they're making RCB look very ordinary. This was a short of a length legbreak outside of, punched to Jadeja's left and Christian doesn't have the legs to beat this throw. His third straight score of 1

name: KA Jamieson
commentary: Tahir's got a direct hit from square leg and Jamieson is walking back! Full ball squeezed out towards square leg, he's sent back and stretching, but he's nowhere close! Tahir waits, takes aim, and throws the stumps down

name: HV Patel
commentary: slides into middle stump! Harshal back in the crease for the pull, doesn't pick the slider. Tahir back after long time, gets his first

name: NA Saini
commentary: sharp take from Raina! Another slider, short of a length outside off. Saini has a quick slash at this. Raina was moving to his right instinctively for the cut, but this speeds into his mid-riff, low to his left, and he reacts fast

name: YS Chahal
commentary: No Commentary

name: Mohammed Siraj
commentary: No Commentary

name: N Rana
commentary: Sakariya finds some extra bounce and has Rana slashing behind. Kicks up slightly from a back of a length and outside off, Rana creates some swinging room, chucks his hands at the ball and edges it behind. KKR's openers have piled the pressure on the middle order

name: Shubman Gill
commentary: Gill has been run-out for an utterly sluggish 11 off 19 balls. Slower cutter, on a yorker length, just a shade outside off. Gill jabs it away just wide of short cover and sets off. But Buttler swoops down on the ball and effects an under-arm direct hit. There wasn't a single there. Perhaps, Gill was just desperate to get out of strike

name: RA Tripathi
commentary: 115.3ks, slower offcutter. Tripathi looks to take it on with a slog-sweep. But he only gets more height as opposed to distance. Dragged from a middle-stump line to Parag at deep midwicket

name: SP Narine
commentary: After dropping one earlier in the evening, Jaiswal finds redemption. In-to-the-pitch offcutter, gets big on Narine. He top-edges a hook high in the air. Jaiswal tears in from long leg, dives forward and takes it with both hands, inches from the ground. Terrific work from Jaiswal

name: EJG Morgan
commentary: pitched up on the stumps, driven ram-rod straight so much it hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. The ball gets deflected to Morris. Tripathi takes a few paces down the pitch, stops. Morgan responds and that results in a mix-up. Morgan then has to undo his steps, but before that Morris flicks it onto his stumps. Morgan has a wry smile on his face as he walks back for a duck without facing a ball. Replays indicate that the ball was deflected off Morgan's bat that was in the way. What an unfortunate way to go. That, by the way, is the first dot ball faced by Tripathi

name: KD Karthik
commentary: overpitched and outside off, Karthik throws his bat at ball and drills it in the air. Sakariya at extra-cover leaps and plucks it out of thin air. Karthik goes for 25 off 24 balls. He couldn't get going either on this used track. End of a double-wicket over from Morris

name: AD Russell
commentary: another on-pace slot ball, but Russell picks out long-on. Pitched up and angling into off and middle, Russell sits back, swishes, and holes out to Miller at the edge of the boundary. Morris wins the match-up. This is the fourth time he has got Russell in T20 cricket

name: PJ Cummins
commentary: Holes out to deep midwicket. Another slower ball short and outside off. Hip-high delivery, pulled flat and hard to Parag. Sharp catch in the outfield

name: Shivam Mavi
commentary: on-pace full-toss outside off, 139.4ks. Mavi shuffles across off and aims to scoop it over short fine leg. However, he just deflects it back onto his own stumps

name: M Prasidh Krishna
commentary: No Commentary

name: JC Buttler
commentary: Varun comes back to pin Buttler lbw. Quick fizzer from Varun again, fuller than the last ball, shaping into middle and rushes in to hit Buttler on his front pad in line with middle as he plays around it. It looks plumb. Buttler has a word with Jaiswal and then walks off, deciding against a review

name: YBK Jaiswal
shorttext: c sub (KL Nagarkoti) b Shivam Mavi
commentary: Holes out to the sub fielder at sweep cover. Much fuller and angling across the left-hander. Jaiswal chucks his hands at the ball and slices it in the air to Nagarkoti

name: SV Samson
commentary: No Commentary

name: S Dube
commentary: Varun provides KKR with the breakthrough! Carved into the lap of short third man. Googly from Varun, he takes it away from the left-hander's swinging arc. Dube still dares to hoick it over midwicket. Instead, he slices it to Krishna

name: R Tewatia
shorttext: c sub (KL Nagarkoti) b Prasidh Krishna
commentary: Krishna bounces out Tewatia. Another chest-high short delivery cramps him on the pull. He can only top-edge it to Nagarkoti at long leg

name: DA Miller
commentary: No Commentary

name: Q de Kock
commentary: dragged straight to mid-on! Length ball outside off, steps out and wants to slap it on the rise over that fielder. It sticks in the pitch and comes off the inside half and floats gently out to Henriques

name: RG Sharma
commentary: whipped straight to deep square. Low full toss at middle stump, gets low and whips this flat. There was a decent gap between deep square and fine leg, but he can't find it. A good knock from Rohit after the early struggles, but Punjab have stated this death overs phase very nicely. A sharp catch from Allen too, high to his right

name: Ishan Kishan
commentary: caught behind! Doesn't even wait for the umpire's decision. Kishan's horror form continues. This is a short of a length slider across off stump. He looks to cut and gets a thin edge, Rahul holds on well. Bishnoi strikes in his first over of the season

name: SA Yadav
commentary: taken at short third! Legbreak, full and outside off. SKY switches up and looks to swing this reverse sweep over backward point. Gets a top edge and it hands up nicely for Gayle

name: KA Pollard
commentary: No Commentary

name: HH Pandya
commentary: full and just outside off, might have been a slower ball. Hardik lines it up and looks to loft this over long-off. Difficult on this surface. Picks out Hooda

name: KH Pandya
commentary: oh superb work from Pooran at sweeper cover! Slower ball, short and turning away outside off. Backs away and cuts aerially. Pooran tracks it to his left, keeps his eyes on it, and dives with the perfect timing to grab it before tumbling softly in his landing to keep it

name: J Yadav
commentary: No Commentary

name: KL Rahul
commentary: No Commentary

name: MA Agarwal
commentary: half-hearted loft finds long-on. Full delivery at leg stump, hurries into this attempted lofted drive over long-on, but he's not committed fully into it. Comes off the inside half and SKY takes it running forward and to his right. Mayank shadow practices a sweep as he walks off

name: CH Gayle
commentary: No Commentary

name: JC Buttler
commentary: hits the top of leg stump! Buttler walks into the leg side and misses on this punch. Short of a length and slanted into leg stump. Not too different from the ball he hit through square leg last over, after walking into the off side. This time he's a long way down leg side with the stumps exposed and he misses the ball

name: M Vohra
commentary: taken by mid-on running to the left! Length ball outside off, Vohra wants to pump that over mid-on. He's not to the pitch of that and it gets big on him. It comes off the toe-end and Richardson tracks back to take that

name: SV Samson
commentary: chipped straight to midwicket! That comes on slow and Samson can't keep it down. Short of a length, turning into the pads. Wants to whip that through vacant midwicket for a single. But that sticks and gets big on him and can only get that to Maxwell's left for a simple take

name: DA Miller
commentary: massive lbw appeal and Kohli reviews. Miller is surprised by the yorker and looks to block it. It gets his bat and rolls out to mid-off, but did it hit his shoe first? It looks like it on first review...and the ball was vey full, it's likely to have pitched in line. It has! That decision will be overturned. A great review, and a great ball. Miller had no idea that was coming. Full and headed for middle and leg stump. Head falling over and foot planted right across the stumps. The move to bat him 4 hasn't worked

name: S Dube
commentary: nicely taken by Maxwell running in. Length ball at leg stump, creates room and has a slog at it, but it's off the toe-end. Dipping quickly as Maxwell runs to the left at long-on and he has to get low very quickly to take this inches off the ground with a lunge. Dube's played his best IPL knock, falls short of a fifty

name: R Parag
commentary: looks to ramp over short fine, gets caught at third man. Can't fault him for one thing - the ball was there for the ramp; But it's off the leading edge. Length ball outside off, drops into the off side to get behind it and manages it. But closes the face too soon. An annoyed Harshal shows him the way to the dugout

name: R Tewatia
shorttext: c Shahbaz Ahmed b Mohammed Siraj
commentary: picks out deep midwicket. Slower short ball just outside off, gets a decent connection on it but there's no pace to play with. It's also the longer side. And he finds the man there

name: CH Morris
commentary: Morris groans as soon as he makes connection on this. It's a full toss at off stump, he's walked across the stumps for the ramp. But he doesn't get low enough, ends up cramping himself, and can only dab this to short fine. RCB's new bowling finisher gets RCB's former bowling finisher

name: S Gopal
commentary: No Commentary

name: C Sakariya
commentary: AB settles under it, calls for it, takes it. Slower ball at a length outside off, Sakariya gets under that and looks to slog. Gets it high but about as far as where short leg would be. AB takes a long sprint and takes it

name: Mustafizur Rahman
commentary: No Commentary

name: V Kohli
commentary: No Commentary

name: D Padikkal
commentary: No Commentary

name: RD Gaikwad
commentary: hauled to deep midwicket, where Cummins takes it. He slog-sweeps it in the air, the outfielder runs in, slides on his knees, and snaffles it. Raina gives the outgoing Gaikwad a high-five. Pushed through outside off, Gaikwad gets hold of the slog, but can't clear Cummins

name: F du Plessis
commentary: No Commentary

name: MM Ali
commentary: four, six, and out! Moeen ventures down the track and swings hard to the leg side again. Narine pulls his length back and brings this back into the left-hander. He misses, DK gathers it and takes the bails off. End of a charming cameo from Moeen

name: MS Dhoni
commentary: scythed flat and hard. Morgan swoops to his left and pulls off an outstanding catch. Wide yorker from Russell, Dhoni reaches out for the ball, hits it hard, and holes out for 17 off 8 balls. 15 off the over, though

name: RA Jadeja
commentary: No Commentary

name: N Rana
commentary: Ngidi runs in from long leg. Dhoni runs across to his left and settles under this skier near the square-leg region. He takes it after a brief stumble. This was on a length and swinging into the pads. Instead of putting it away to the fence, Rana skews it in the air off a leading edge and gives his wicket away

name: Shubman Gill
