commentary: it happened like clockwork. Lured him out of his crease with a flighted delivery, but it pitches and turns across him. Patel had no clue as he wafts at it. No connection made and the keeper whips off the bails. All too easy

name: MG Johnson
commentary: through him first ball! Reaches forward but he has a big gap between bat and pad as he played down the wrong line. The ball turns in and off stump is knocked back

name: L Balaji
commentary: that's three in the over! Balaji goes for a sweep across the line and is caught in front of middle. This pitched on a good length and skidded onto him, strikes on the knee-roll and that's a pretty easy decision for Umpire Dharmasena

name: Sandeep Sharma
commentary: No Commentary

name: MK Pandey
commentary: that's been given! This time it's the indipper and Pandey was pushing down the wrong line. A lovely length from the bowler, he knows his strength is swing and sticks to it. Half-push forward and is struck around the knee-roll.

name: JH Kallis
commentary: and he strikes straight away! Punjab are making a fight of this! This was a good length ball outside off, Kallis goes forward and unleashes one of his square drives. But he fails to keep it to ground and Maxwell makes no mistake

name: G Gambhir
commentary: not a duck this time, but is that enough of a silver lining for the KKR captain though. Oh, but wait we're checking the bowler's front foot now. It was a length ball on middle, Gambhir cleared his front leg and looked to slash it through the covers. The bat face turns on impact and he holes out to short extra cover

name: CA Lynn
commentary: the stumps are in disarray! It was quick and flat and Lynn's expansive hit down the ground amounts to worse than nothing. Punjab's players are skipping about here

name: RV Uthappa
commentary: legcutter outside off. Uthappa dabs into the covers and sets off. But Bailey swoops in, picks up and throws in one motion and has hit the base of the stumps. Uthappa had almost given up

name: YK Pathan
commentary: this stays low after darting in at the pads. Pathan was trying to flick across the line and has been judged leg before. Would have clipped leg stump

name: SA Yadav
commentary: that's the end of that then. Back of a length and outside off, he looks to force the pace with a loft over the off side. Hits him a little too high on the bat and cover makes no mistake. Fooled by the shorter ball

name: PP Chawla
commentary: races down the track and he looks for a loft it over the covers. But this goes on with the arm and the keeper pulls off a smart stumping

name: SP Narine
commentary: off stump is uprooted and Johnson roars! Goes full and Narine was backing away and looking to loft it over the covers. The batsman misses, Johnson hits. Bet he remembered Narine making a fool of him in the first innnings. That's the time out now

name: UT Yadav
commentary: slower ball cleans up middle stump. It was full, Umesh was not interested in getting in line as he offers a terrible excuse of a shot. Rooted to the crease and soundly beaten as he played inside the line

name: M Morkel
commentary: No Commentary

name: RG Sharma
commentary: more seam into him and Rohit wants a quick single after dabbing it into leg. But Shami has seen an opportunity, darted across, picked up with one hand and aimed base of middle. Rohit was miles out.

name: AP Tare
commentary: deep midwicket steadies himself under it and takes it easily. It was short around the off stump, Tare shifted back and swung seeking to clear the boundary but QDK ran to his left and completes a straightforward take

name: CJ Anderson
commentary: rank long hop and Anderson has thumped it straight to deep midwicket! Unadkat raises his hands in triumph and Anderson is in disbelief. The pull was quite well timed, but like Tare he picked the only fielder there

name: AT Rayudu
commentary: picks out long-on! It was flighted on off stump and he steps out and decided to go for the big one. Heaves it over the top but connects off the toe. Simple catch

name: MEK Hussey
commentary: what a beauty! This is a loopy, slower yorker off the back of the hand. Huss had to wait ages and ages and ages but when he finally jams the bat down he misses and gets his off stump pegged

name: KA Pollard
commentary: No Commentary

name: CM Gautam
commentary: he's lost grip of the bat while heaving at a fuller ball on middle and leg. Should only have been a single down to deep midwicket and calls a bewildered Gautam through for a non-existent double. Good throw from the deep sees Mumbai's top-scorer well short

name: Harbhajan Singh
commentary: No Commentary

name: Z Khan
commentary: No Commentary

name: Q de Kock
commentary: what a ripper from Hussey at point! It was cut pretty well and he had to dive full length and low to his left. Holds on with two hands and QDK has to walk back.

name: M Vijay
commentary: off stump knocked back as Vijay goes for an awful slog. Nothing particularly threatening about the delivery, the batsman just went for too optimistic a stroke. Underestimated Rohit, I suppose

name: JP Duminy
commentary: caught in the covers! Slices a fuller ball with an open face and he picks out the fielder. Mumbai rejoice. Is this going to turn out into a low-scoring thriller too? Tune in after the time out

name: KP Pietersen
commentary: No Commentary

name: KD Karthik
commentary: Mumbai dug-out and the fans have woken up! Rayudu at short midwicket has pulled off another important catch and Malinga magic seems inevitable. It was full on middle and he's just clipped it straight to the fielder

name: KM Jadhav
commentary: No Commentary

name: AJ Finch
commentary: Mohit's bowled another batsman with one of those back-of-the-hand slower balls. Finch was done heaving across the line by the time the ball arrived. Middle stump took a beating. Finch goes without finding high gear

name: S Dhawan
commentary: he's tried that shot again and he's gone! Dhawan swivelled to pull a short of a length delivery and hit it straight to Mithun Manhas at midwicket. Once again he was cramped for room

name: DA Warner
commentary: a huge appeal for lbw and the umpire gives him out after a while! Hilfenhaus' appeal was long and convincing! That's a shocking decision. The ball pitched short of a length well outside leg stump and struck Warner way too high on the pads too. He tried to force it through midwicket and missed. Warner looks quite bewildered at the decision and has every right to be. He was off his toes when the ball hit the top of his pad. Not out on every count.

name: KL Rahul
commentary: he's smashed that, hit it well, but picked out the fielder on the deep midwicket boundary! The ball was short and Rahul pulled hard, the ball flew flat and straight to Ishwar Pandey, who barely had to move to take the catch

name: Y Venugopal Rao
commentary: driven on the up and straight to mid-off, that's the end of Rao. He made good contact with the shot but did not get enough height on it, the ball traveled flat and dead straight to Dwayne Smith

name: DJG Sammy
commentary: No Commentary

name: KV Sharma
commentary: No Commentary

name: DR Smith
commentary: caught at long-off! Warner comes charging in and tumbles after holding a well-judged catch on the run. It was a low full toss and Smith didn't hit it as cleanly as he has been doing all evening. He's all but won CSK the game though

name: BB McCullum
commentary: bowled him! The length was too full to cut, the line was too straight to cut, it was the googly too. McCullum went back in a flash but was beaten. The ball hit off and middle stump

name: SK Raina
shorttext: c Venugopal Rao b I Sharma
commentary: caught on the sweeper boundary. Raina charges and aims to hit straight but ends up slicing a length ball to Rao. An easy catch. Ishant's front foot is fine too.

name: MS Dhoni
commentary: No Commentary

name: F du Plessis
commentary: caught behind! Faf's gone first ball. He tries to drive away from his body at a good length delivery that seams away. A healthy edge that carries comfortably to the keeper Rahul

name: RA Jadeja
commentary: he's been bowled! The length was a bit too full to stay back to. The line was too straight to try and steer towards point. There was a gap between bat and pad and Ishant went straight through it to hit middle stump. the ball actually nipped back into the left-hander, grazed the thigh and then hit the stumps

name: M Manhas
commentary: No Commentary

name: CH Gayle
commentary: bowled! Gayle is down the track, but plays down the wrong line as the ball shapes away from him and beats his outside edge before crashing into off stump.

name: PA Patel
commentary: He's gone! Identical delivery, Parthiv goes for a big on-the-up drive, edges through to Saha.

name: V Kohli
commentary: LBW! Billy's given it! Bit more shape into the right-hander, and Kohli is struck on the front pad. It seemed to be heading down the leg side, and he had taken a pretty big stride out.

name: YV Takawale
commentary: Pokes tentatively at a length ball angled across him, and gets a thick edge through to the keeper. Takawale is out for a seven-ball duck. Umpires check for the no-ball. They seem to be looking at his back foot and the return crease. No problem.

name: AB de Villiers
commentary: big wicket here, AB is gone to a short and wide ball, slaps that straight to backward point, he didn't try to power that one, guided perfectly towards the fielder, no threat in the delivery, AB has given it away

name: Yuvraj Singh
commentary: bad ball, bad shot, and there's a wicket, a short ball that sits up for Yuvraj, who tries to slam it over deep midwicket, instead picks out the fielder there, Miller takes a simple catch, this is just the 15th over, and Yuvraj was the last remaining batsman

name: JA Morkel
commentary: length ball angling across, Albie goes for another powerful hit, thick inside edge and that crashes into the stumps, Balaji gets rid of another overseas batsman, he dismissed all four of them in the Sunrisers game

name: MA Starc
commentary: slower yorker, 123.3kph, was heading down the leg side, Starc had made a bit of room, but he couldn't get bat on that full one, off the pads and onto the stumps

name: VR Aaron
commentary: No Commentary

name: AB Dinda
commentary: No Commentary

name: CA Pujara
commentary: He's gone! Leans back and tries to steer it to third man, ends up edging it to the keeper.

name: V Sehwag
commentary: Chahal gets another! Parthiv gets in the act again as Sehwag tries to cut a legbreak. Replays suggest there was no outside edge, though.

name: WP Saha
commentary: What a catch! Mitchell Starc, running to his left from fine leg, takes it coolly in his stride, inches from the rope, as Saha plays a pick-up shot off a length ball on leg stump.

name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: Starc takes another! Maxwell pulls, but doesn't hit it too cleanly, and Starc has to run in from the ropes and dive forward to cup it inches from the ground.

name: DA Miller
commentary: lovely delivery. Googly tossed up outside off, and Miller follows it with his hands, trying to hit it square but only managing an outside edge to Parthiv, who takes a good sharp catch.

name: GJ Bailey
commentary: No Commentary

name: R Dhawan
commentary: No Commentary

name: AM Rahane
commentary: Rahane sensed this would be full and wide again, he moves outside off but Vinay goes wider and Rahane's only dragged it tamely to long on

name: KK Nair
commentary: Nair charges out to a good length delivery, it comes in a bit after pitching and goes past his heave to hit the top of the stumps

name: SV Samson
commentary: he goes back to a full delivery and pays for it, Samson tries to make room outside leg, but the ball does not turn, it carries onto hit him low on the pad and rolls onto the stumps

name: SR Watson
commentary: what a gifted wicket, full toss outside off, Watson pummels it through the covers, throw comes in from the sweeper, two bounces to the keeper, Watson is not really charging back, he realises he needs to dive, but he's fallen short by inches, Pandey's been sharp in the field tonight

name: STR Binny
commentary: Binny goes first ball, backs away a bit, Morkel goes short of a length and widish outside off, Binny stretches to have a go at the cut, but nicks it behind

name: SPD Smith
commentary: No Commentary

name: JP Faulkner
commentary: No Commentary

name: G Gambhir
commentary: Bhatia's struck, Gambhir's swept a cutter off his pads high and straight to deep square leg

name: MS Bisla
commentary: bowls it on a good length wide outside off, it comes in a bit, Bisla attacks it, but can only thick edge to slip, who moves to his left to take a head-high catch

name: JH Kallis
commentary: Smith runs in from long off and takes this skier, after Kallis top-edges a slog-sweep to this tossed up full delivery just outside off

name: MK Pandey
commentary: plumb, Tambe comes back by slipping in the quicker one, Pandey is caught clueless and he is right in front

name: SA Yadav
commentary: Faulkner's kept this alive, Yadav's skied this full and wide one slanted across him, and Smith has run in from long off and taken it in front of his head

name: Shakib Al Hasan
commentary: No Commentary

name: RV Uthappa
commentary: Uthappa's gone too far across, Faulkner bowls the slower one from back of the hand, good length on middle and leg, Uthappa misses, and Faulkner hits

name: R Vinay Kumar
commentary: Faulkner keeps hitting the stumps, another slower one, full on off stump this time, Vinay swings and misses

name: PP Chawla
commentary: a run-out now, Shakib backs away and forces a full delivery to long on, Chawla wants the second, Shakib does not and raises his hand, but Chawla is too far out already and is run out by miles as Smith fires it to the keeper

name: SP Narine
commentary: No Commentary

name: AJ Finch
commentary: spooned to cover! Zaheer fired that on a good length outside off, Finch was looking to punch it through the off side but failed to keep it down, Dunk jumps at cover and takes it easily

name: S Dhawan
commentary: Zak's struck back after the boundary, this was on a good length outside off, Dhawan didn't have the width to drive unlike the previous ball, he went for the drive anyway, took the outside edge and comfortably taken by Harbhajan at first slip

name: KL Rahul
commentary: soft dismissal for Rahul, he moved across his stumps looking to scoop it to fine leg, it was the off cutter, top edged it and an easy one for Gautam

name: DA Warner
commentary: Warner tries one switch hit too many! Anderson was round the wicket, it was full and Warner was looking to send that over deep midwicket (to the right-hander), thick edge to the keeper

name: DJG Sammy
commentary: brilliantly done by Pollard! Slower ball from Anderson and Sammy fetched that from outside off and looked to clear long-on, didn't get the distance and Pollard ran forward, kept his eyes on it and took it inches off the turf on the dive

name: NV Ojha
commentary: No Commentary

name: IK Pathan
commentary: No Commentary

name: BR Dunk
commentary: the keeper is up to the stumps, Dunk was at the crease looking to pull, Sammy bowled the off cutter and it skidded through, deflected off the pads and onto the stumps

name: RG Sharma
commentary: big gap between bat and pad as he exhibits a lazy drive down the ground. Bhuvi gets this to dart back in quite late  and off stump takes a clattering. Mumbai's batting is treading familiar territory once again

name: CJ Anderson
commentary: what a ball! Anderson has had a torrid time against the pace Steyn is generating. So he goes for the innovation. Gets on one-knee and looks to scoop a short of a good length delivery over the keeper. Unwise shot against someone of this pace. Only gloves it and the keeper pouches an easy take

name: AT Rayudu
commentary: the bowling change has worked! Irfan bowls this quite wide outside off and Rayudu has to really fetch that, playing against the line of the ball, he slogs but finds Warner at deep midwicket

name: KA Pollard
commentary: inside edge! Irfan bowls round the wicket and swings it towards the stumps, Pollard looks to swipe it across the line but gets an inside edge onto the stumps, Pathan's animated and Mumbai have lost their best hope

name: AP Tare
commentary: Tare backs away to give himself room for the big hit, he fetches it high on the body and gets a top edge that goes miles up in the air, the keeper Ojha does the honours

name: Harbhajan Singh
commentary: the captain's done the honors, this was fired in full on the stumps, he made room to slam that wide of cover but ended up smacking it to Dhawan at cover

name: CM Gautam
commentary: No Commentary

name: Z Khan
commentary: No Commentary

name: DR Smith
commentary: he's got him, after all! tries to sweep, misses. Ball straightens and hits his back pad, in front of the stumps. That looked plumb.

name: BB McCullum
commentary: Russell strikes! full ball, wide of off stump, McCullum goes low and slashes, but it slices off his bat and straight into the hands of deep point.

name: SK Raina
shorttext: c Yadav b Shakib Al Hasan
commentary: he's gone! comes down the track and hits a full-toss straight down the throat of long-on. He seemed to cramp himself for room, and didn't get a free swing of his arms.

name: MS Dhoni
commentary: No Commentary

name: RA Jadeja
commentary: No Commentary

name: RV Uthappa
commentary: he's been missing the reverse-sweep for a while, and the shot gets Uthappa out now. Off his glove, into the forearm, and lobs in the air for Dhoni to pouch running a few steps to his right. Jadeja appeals like mad, and the umpire tells him to turn around. Uthappa had already started walking.

name: G Gambhir
commentary: run out! Uthappa takes two steps down and inside-edges as he tries to swat across the line. Gambhir sets off for a run even though the ball is in Dhoni's hands. Hilfenhaus collects the keeper's throw halfway down the pitch, runs back and underarms it to the stumps.

name: JH Kallis
commentary: Bad ball gets Kallis! Wide outside leg stump, and he sweeps uppishly, straight to deep backward square leg, one of two fielders on the leg-side boundary.

name: MK Pandey
commentary: and he gets a wicket first ball! Stops on Pandey outside off stump, and he checks his shot halfway into a drive, pops it straight into cover's hands.

name: Shakib Al Hasan
commentary: No he can't! Slogs his first ball straight to deep midwicket, where Mohit Sharma takes a good catch diving forward and to his left. Ball was swirling quite a bit.

name: SA Yadav
commentary: Another skidder, another failed sweep, and the finger goes up for the lbw shout. The ball hits Yadav on the back thigh, and he might be a touch unlucky, because that hit him on a line a little bit outside off.

name: YK Pathan
commentary: Full, angled in, lbw. Pathan looks to slog across the line, and misses. Hits him right in front of off stump. Plumb.

name: AD Russell
commentary: Another slower-ball, another across-the-line heave, another batsman beaten. This time, it's straight, and it crashes into middle stump.

name: PP Chawla
commentary: Full, wide outside off, and Chawla swings it straight down long-off's throat.

name: R Vinay Kumar
commentary: No Commentary

name: SP Narine
commentary: No Commentary

name: CA Pujara
commentary: Pujara's cameo is over! Anderson gave him lots of width again and the ball seamed across him from over the wicket, Pujara chased after it and tried to drive through cover but got an edge through to the keeper

name: V Sehwag
commentary: Sehwag's been run out! He cut the ball firmly to point where the fielder dived to his right and half-stopped the ball. Rohit moved to his left from cover, picked up the ball with his left hand, transferred it to his right as he turned around and threw down the stumps at the bowler's end. Sehwag was well short. He had hesitated to run until the first fielder made his stop so that delay cost him

name: WP Saha
commentary: No Commentary

name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: caught at long on! Maxwell's gone and Mumbai are ecstatic. Maxwell came down the track but didn't get to the pitch of the ball, he went through with the shot and mis-hit it straight to Ben Dunk on the boundary. Perhaps the pressure of no runs from Saha got to him in the end ...

name: GJ Bailey
commentary: caught at deep square leg! Bailey slog sweeps but mis-times it woefully, Anderson comes running in and then stoops to catch the ball with fingers pointing up even though it was a low take

name: DA Miller
commentary: two dots and now a wicket, this is an exceptional final over from Malinga, Miller has struggled against Malinga and this time he ended up hitting a low full toss with the bottom of the bat, mis-timing it towards long on. Ben dunk ran in quickly and dived forward to catch the ball. Terrific take

name: MG Johnson
commentary: No Commentary

name: BR Dunk
commentary: that's an outstanding catch from Saha! He's having a good game! Dunk drove away from his body at one that swung away from him on a good length outside off stump, the edge flew quickly but Saha dived to his left to take it smoothly

name: CM Gautam
commentary: lbw! One cute reverse shot too many from Gautham. Dhawan kept it simple, wicket to wicket and on a good length. Gautham tried to reverse swat off the back foot and he missed. The ball hit him plumb in front

name: AT Rayudu
commentary: lbw! That ball snaked late into the right-hander, bending sharply from far outside off stump, Rayudu had moved across his crease and was right in front of the stumps when the ball crashed into his front pad below the knee roll. Plumb.

name: RG Sharma
commentary: Saha takes an easy catch! Rohit backed away to leg and closed the face to play the ball through square leg. He played too early and the ball lobbed tamely off the leading edge behind the wicket to Saha

name: CJ Anderson
commentary: Anderson fails to see it through! He tries to hit a good length ball over the long-off boundary and doesn't connect properly. Miller is ready and waiting for the catch

name: KA Pollard
commentary: No Commentary

name: AP Tare
commentary: No Commentary

name: Q de Kock
commentary: another one, Tambe, you legend! Looped it on off stump and De Kock could not resist. Went for a drive against the turn and the ball pitched just before his flaying blade, took the inside half of it and sat safely in the hands of the bowler himself. Tambe was pushed to the floor while taking the catch, but he had it under control

name: M Vijay
commentary: and produces magic straight away. Vijay looks to force the pace off a back of a good length delivery and has spooned a catch to mid-off. Would have done better to punch off the back foot, but Vijay is most comfortable pressing forward. Went through with the shot and the bat face turned on impact. Ends up a simple catch after Watson called mine

name: KP Pietersen
commentary: picks out long-on! This skewed off the inside half of the bat and it's Steven Smith down there. You know the rest of it. Tossed up and he looked to take it on. His timing fails him and this time the umps don't bother about the front-foot no-ball check

name: KD Karthik
commentary: holes out at deep square leg! Another crucial wicket at a crucial time for Royals. Dug in short and he chose to take it on. Hit high on the bat as he looked to pull. The man in the deep hardly had to move

name: JP Duminy
commentary: what a catch! Bhatia has picked up a sensational catch while skirting the long leg boundary! This was full and on leg stump and again sat up for Duminy to swing away. The fielder had to run to his right, had his eyes on it all the way and pouched it. But then he made sure he kept his balance. Faulkner was right beside him just in case he couldn't and needed assistance

name: KM Jadhav
commentary: No Commentary

name: WD Parnell
commentary: No Commentary

name: AM Rahane
commentary: how bout that! M Vijay has pulled off a screamer and took a leaf out of Dwayne Bravo's book and did a little jig. This was fuller and teasing him outside off, Rahane got forward and timed his cover drive quite well. Only he didn't keep it down. Vijay dives to his left and plucks out a low one

name: KK Nair
commentary: No Commentary

name: SV Samson
commentary: tossed up and outside off, Samson reaches out to lash it through the covers. Misses and his momentum ruins his balance. The keeper waits on the back foot to lift and then whips off the bails. Promising innings cut short

name: R Bhatia
commentary: there we go, the offcutter has flattened off stump! Bhatia saw length and went for a slog, But he hasn't spotted the variation, which grips the pitch and darts back in to hit timber. Is this the start of something?

name: SR Watson
commentary: No Commentary

name: AJ Finch
commentary: Starc bounces out Finch, a 140 kph lifter into the body, Finch tries to gather himself into playing a hook, but it rises up too fast, and he's in no position to play the shot, he is hopping in the air, trying to half-fend, half-hook, and only ends up looping it to the keeper

name: S Dhawan
commentary: not the first time Dhawan's fallen to the pull, he's mishit it to AB at deep midwicket, it was a short ball around chest height

name: KL Rahul
commentary: this was short and wide, but Rahul has edged the cut, and Gayle has moved to his left at slip to take a head-high catch

name: DA Warner
commentary: he's missed a final time this innings, walked across outside off stump, Starc went full on middle, and hit it

name: DJG Sammy
commentary: the slower one at 118 kph works for Harshal, a length ball cutting in from outside off, Sammy wants to deposit it over deep midwicket but it comes off slowly and bounces, he mishits it to straight the fielder

name: NV Ojha
commentary: full and wide, Ojha reaches for it, but he hasn't gone too hard at it, and ends up slicing it to Starc, who runs to his left from sweeper cover to take it

name: IK Pathan
commentary: No Commentary

name: KV Sharma
commentary: No Commentary

name: CH Gayle
commentary: the legspinner has struck big first over, Gayle has swung this flat and  pitched up delivery off his pad straight to Sammy at deep midwicket

name: PA Patel
commentary: Bhuvneshwar strikes first ball, he bowls it on a good length around off, it is swinging away a bit, Parthiv drives at it without much feet, and plays on

name: V Kohli
commentary: they have the big one, Bhuvneshwar ends a superb over on a high, this was much shorter than the length he had been bowling, it swung away, Kohli saw some width to cut, and nicked it through to the keeper

name: RR Rossouw
commentary: loud, long appeal for leg-before, Karn tosses it up full on the stumps, Rossouw tries the reverse sweep, misses and is struck right in front

name: AB de Villiers
commentary: No Commentary

name: Yuvraj Singh
shorttext: c sub (MC Henriques) b KV Sharma
commentary: Yuvraj is gone now, he's swept it to deep backward square leg, Henriques the substitute is there in the deep, he steadies himself at the edge of the rope and takes it over his head

name: MA Starc
commentary: Starc forces the length ball to mid off, but is found well short on the direct hit

name: HV Patel
commentary: No Commentary

name: AM Rahane
commentary: direct hit has cut short Rahane's innings! or has it? It always looked like a risky single. Karun flicked the short of length delivery straight to short fine leg... It just went too quickly to the fielder.. Narine does well and throws down the stumps at the striker's end. Rahane dived.. but was always going to be short

name: KK Nair
commentary: he misses out on his half-century! That was smartly bowled by Shakib. He saw the batsman making a move down the pitch and fired it full outside off.. Nair was stranded down the pitch.. no chance for him

name: SV Samson
commentary: marginally short and Sanju makes a good connection with his pull shot, but that has gone higher than longer and is comfortably taken by Pandey at deep midwicket

name: SR Watson
commentary: tossed up!! And what about that catch! KKR are pulling these blinders in this IPL.. Watson had reached the pitch of the delivery and it was well on his way over the long-on boundary.. But Surya waits at the edge of the boundary, and stretches outward to take that brilliantly.. He manages to keep his balance too.. Wonderful effort

name: STR Binny
shorttext: c ten Doeschate b Vinay Kumar
commentary: another good catch in the deep! this time it's Tendo.. Binny whacked the low full toss straight towards deep midwicket.. Tendo was slightly inside the boundary and was expecting it to drop down towards him.. but that was hit hard and didn't look like coming down.. in the end he had to time his leap to get to that..

name: SPD Smith
shorttext: c SA Yadav b Vinay Kumar
commentary: slower delivery, he looks for the big hit, but his timing is awry and that lobs up gently for the long on fielder

name: JP Faulkner
commentary: No Commentary

name: R Bhatia
commentary: No Commentary

name: RV Uthappa
commentary: second one in three balls now! Slower delivery, Uthappa flicks it straight to deep square leg.. that didn't even threaten the boundary.. Tame dismissal. Never too far from some late drama

name: G Gambhir
commentary: Watson strikes first ball! Gambhir cleared his front leg out and was looking to crash it over extra cover, but gets a thick outside edge to the keeper

name: AD Russell
commentary: he has knocked the middle stump down! perfect slower delivery! The batsman moved to the leg side and played down the wrong line.. Watson gives him a cold stare of death..no words.. The eyes said it all

name: MK Pandey
commentary: he is gone! Common sense is up in smoke! Manish walks out of the crease far too early and Tambe fires this down the leg side.. He had no chance

name: Shakib Al Hasan
commentary: No Commentary

name: YK Pathan
commentary: this is madness! Yusuf has got a golden duck! This was full and Yusuf drives it back to the bowler.. KKR are imploding in the most incredible fashion

name: RN ten Doeschate
commentary: Tambe, you beaut!!! he is got the hat-trick! Tendo watches the umpire for some time.. He is surprised but the call.. but this is over.. He tossed it up, Tendo was coming forward to play and gets hit on the toe on full.. that is an excellent decision.. What drama!

name: SA Yadav
commentary: No Commentary

name: Q de Kock
commentary: terrible mixup! Vijay went forward and pushed this behind point and they set off quickly and completed two, Raina dived at the boundary and parried it to Jadeja who flung it to the bowler, however Vijay was keeping his eye on the fielder and didn't want the third, de Kock had charged off for the third and was halfway down and had to scamper back, Mohit took aim and de Kock was out by miles

name: M Vijay
commentary: Vijay can't clear long-off! This was a length ball outside off and Vijay was at the crease and on his knee looking to slap that over long-off, went off the bottom half of the bat and du Plessis runs to his right and takes it

name: KP Pietersen
commentary: the off stump's down and KP's gone for a golden duck! The keeper was up to the stumps, Mohit bowled a length ball on the off stump and it skidded through, KP played down the wrong line and his stump was flattened

name: KD Karthik
commentary: Mohit's claimed the catch inches off the ground at square leg and Karthik's waiting for the umpires to have a look. Hilfenhaus came round the wicket, Karthik looked to whip it across the line and it went flat to Mohit, he dived forward and to his left and the third umpire Shamsuddin takes his time on this one and Karthik has to go

name: LR Shukla
commentary: soft dismissal! Tossed up and he was down the track and ended up getting a leading edge that lobbed to Pandey at long-off

name: JP Duminy
commentary: No Commentary

name: KM Jadhav
commentary: No Commentary

name: DR Smith
commentary: Vijay takes it at the edge of the straight boundary! It was a full ball outside off and Smith stayed at the crease and lofted it down the ground, it went really high and really tested Vijay near the rope but he kept his cool and took it nonchalantly

name: BB McCullum
commentary: finally a wicket for Delhi, this was a length ball on middle and McCullum made a bit of room to pound this over long-on, didn't time it very well and it went flat to Vijay

name: SK Raina
commentary: No Commentary

name: MS Dhoni
commentary: No Commentary

name: BR Dunk
shorttext: c Yuvraj Singh b HV Patel
commentary: the bowling change works for RCB, loose shot by Dunk, length ball angling in and Dunk was looking to chip this over mid-off, tamely lobbed it to Yuvraj at that position, wicket straightaway for Harshal

name: CM Gautam
commentary: much easier for Parthiv this time, this was a loose drive, chasing at one angling away from him outside the off stump, thick edge and taken by Parthiv

name: AT Rayudu
commentary: the middle stumps is flattened and Dinda has his revenge after leaking plenty, this was coming back in, fuller ball, Rayudu playing down the wrong line

name: RG Sharma
commentary: No Commentary

name: CJ Anderson
commentary: Anderson's second attempt at clearing long-on in the same over doesn't fetch the same result, he fetched this from outside off and slogged, went high in the air and Kohli was well in front of the rope when he took it

name: KA Pollard
commentary: Starc's won this battle! Pollard moved right across his stumps to paddle that and he missed, Rohit had set off for the bye and Parthiv underarmed it to the bowler, Pollard had no option to amble out because Rohit was already at his end, Starc gestures to Pollard to come to his end and then whips off the bails aggressively

name: AP Tare
commentary: No Commentary

name: CH Gayle
commentary: Harbhajan's got the Big Fish and Gayle can't believe it! Harbhajan bowls round the wicket and the ball straightens, Gayle was down to slog and he was too early on the shot and the ball struck the off stump, Harbhajan is on his knee and pumps his fist and stays there

name: PA Patel
commentary: slog and a miss, Harbhajan tosses it up from round the wicket, lands on a good length and Parthiv plays too early and the ball hits his stumps

name: V Kohli
commentary: Anderson plucks that at long-off and Kohli has to go, this was pitched up on the off stump and Kohli aims for a flat six over long-off, Anderson moved to his right quickly and judged it well, it must have thudded onto his palm because Kohli hit that hard

name: AB de Villiers
commentary: Bumrah does what Steyn couldn't do the other night! He knocks down the leg stump as AB attempts one of his audacious sweep shots, moved right across his stumps, the angle was taking it towards the leg stump, it goes for a spin and lands a few yards back

name: Yuvraj Singh
commentary: that's a goal by Pollard! Rossouw looks to pull and gets an inside edge to the body and the ball drops in front of him, they take the single and Yuvraj was struggling, Pollard senses he wouldn't have time to pick up and throw so he settles for the kick and boots the ball towards the stumps and Yuvi was short

name: RR Rossouw
commentary: scoops to cover, this was the slower ball by Malinga, Rossouw gave the charge and looked to clear the off side, chipped it to Rohit at cover

name: MA Starc
commentary: and as many of you would have hoped for Starc's gone and with a little help from Pollard, this was fired full outside off and he tries to clear the off side and ends up scooping it to Pollard at cover

name: HV Patel
commentary: knocks the off stump down this time, it was the off cutter, Harshal shuffled across and he wasn't too sure what he was trying, walked all around it and the ball brushed his hip and hit the off stump which lands a couple of yards back

name: VR Aaron
commentary: No Commentary

name: AB Dinda
commentary: No Commentary

name: Q de Kock
commentary: one dot, two dot, and here comes the wicket! He looked to clear this fuller delivery over mid-on, but is hit high on the bat and lobs up for Gambhir at mid-on. After two inswinging deliveries, this one went straight on

name: M Vijay
commentary: he has given it away.. Murali looks to launch the length delivery outside off to the long-on boundary.. But he never really looked in control.. Easy catch for Narine at the boundary

name: KP Pietersen
commentary: what has he done! This is the most stupid dismissal. He comes forward, defends it to cover and just starts running like a mad man. There was no run there.. The keeper moves forward, picks up the ball and runs him out.. KP never really looked back..

name: KD Karthik
shorttext: c Kallis b Shakib Al Hasan
commentary: it's the end! He was looking so good, but as he looks to whack this leg side delivery to deep backward square leg, what he manages is a top-edge that lobs up for Kallis at short fine leg

name: JP Duminy
commentary: No Commentary

name: LR Shukla
commentary: this is too good! it was quicker and honing in on the middle stump. Shukla moved to the leg side expecting it to turn into him, but this just goes straight on and flattens the middle stump

name: KM Jadhav
commentary: No Commentary

name: RV Uthappa
commentary: the finger has been raised after a pause! Uthappa was looking to punch this down the ground, but he was walking into this shot.. so slightly off balance.. he plays outside the line of the delivery and is in front of off stump. Good decision by the umpire. Uthappa misses out on a half-century

name: G Gambhir
commentary: Whoa! DK takes a screamer! I was looking at the boundary but DK has leaped a few feet in the air to pluck that out of nowhere! Gambhir went for the pull on a short delivery and got a thick top edge that looked like it was going over the keeper, but DK catches it with his right hand.. Parnell, KP .. all are impressed with that

name: MK Pandey
commentary: No Commentary

name: JH Kallis
commentary: No Commentary

name: V Sehwag
commentary: Oh, he's dragged on! He dabbed at a good length delivery with an angled blade and Hilfy manages to nip it back enough to take the inside edge, hit the pads and cannon into the stumps

name: Mandeep Singh
commentary: walks down, makes room and carves this straight down third man's throat. That was not his job, all he needed to do was put Sehwag on strike but he couldn't help himself. Tried to manufacture a stroke but gets more of a thick outside edge

name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: again! He's holed out at deep midwicket. This was a little slower and fuller outside off, Maxi wound up and slogged. Dragging it might have hurt him for power and Jaddu took it safely inside the rope and then teased fate by walking back to the boundary and acting as if he was about to step over it. What's the point of a wicket if you can't have a bit of fun with it

name: DA Miller
commentary: Smith does it again! Last time he got Maxi, this time he gets Miller! It was full and he was looking to lash it through the covers. Gets an inside edge that uproots off stump. Threw his head back in disappointment, he was three away from a fifty but besides that Punjab were batting Chennai into submission

name: GJ Bailey
commentary: No Commentary

name: MG Johnson
commentary: No Commentary

name: DR Smith
commentary: they get the big fish early! Smith looks to hoick the back of length delivery over point, but gets a thick edge that lobs up for Mitchell Johnson at backward point

name: BB McCullum
commentary: skips down the track for a couple to deep midwicket, but wait this is a direct hit! Mitchell Johnson collected the ball with one hand and hurled it on target at the bowlers'. McCullum was carrying his helmet while he was rushing between the wickets and is caught short by a few inches. What a throw, swift, flat and dead on.

name: SK Raina
commentary: Maxi and Miller, they combine well even with the ball in hand! Raina dances down the track to heave a flighted ball over extra cover. But he doesn't get enough timing on it. Long off runs up and dives forward to complete the catch.

name: RA Jadeja
commentary: was that bowled? The good length ball stayed a little low and skidded through Jaddu's hurried prod. They're going to the third ump to see if the bails were disturbed by the ball and not the keeper's gloves. And we have confirmation of that. Except, Dhawan's front foot almost seemed to have toed the line. It certainly slipped over, but when he landed it he was fine. Well, it doesn't matter now. Jaddu has to walk back

name: F du Plessis
commentary: goes outside off to try and scoop it over the head of short fine leg, but the connection is too feeble. Kartik moves to his left and collects a simple catch

name: MS Dhoni
commentary: the top hand came off the bat as he goes for the pull. But this Johnson short ball was a little too quick for him. Top edge caught easily at midwicket

name: M Manhas
commentary: No Commentary

name: R Ashwin
commentary: No Commentary

name: S Dhawan
commentary: he is got him! That has taken an outside edge from the offstump! Too close for a cut actually.. He was neither forward, nor backward.. A poor short from Dhawan just after he was starting to find his touch

name: AJ Finch
commentary: Rahane you beauty! He runs in from the deep midwicket boundary, dives forward and takes a blinder. This was a length ball and Finch, as is his wont, swung across the line but didn't make a great connection.. it looked like it was going to drop much short but Rahane ran in quick and slid under it.. A bit like Jadeja taking that catch to dismiss Allan Border in the 1992 WC

name: KL Rahul
commentary: poor poor shot! Bhatia does what Bhatia does.. Slower delivery outside off, Rahul plays a sweep like he would have against a spinner, misses it completely and loses his offstump..What a shot to play after playing a number of good-looking straight-batted shots.. Sign of the tiimes

name: NV Ojha
commentary: Bhatia downs another one! this is a slow legcutter on off, Naman Ojha tries to steer it fine on the off side and loses his offstump

name: DA Warner
commentary: superbly done from Tambe, tosses it up more than he usually does, the line is on middle, Warner takes the bait and rushes out, has a swipe, but this is the googly, turns away, and he is stumped

name: MC Henriques
commentary: he comes and picks up the wicket immediately! What a guy.. That was a length delivery, asking to be hit, Henriques clobbers it flat towards long-off where Rahane takes another good catch..

name: IK Pathan
commentary: No Commentary

name: KV Sharma
commentary: another one! This is a hat-trick for Watson. Angled delivery, it's steered straight to the hands of the keeper. Ahmedabad is proving real lucky for Royals! Second hat-trick in two games

name: DW Steyn
commentary: and another one! This is too wide though but Irfan runs for a bye.. Steyn has to pay the price as Sanju takes down the stumps..

name: A Mishra
commentary: What a comedy! The batsman misses the shot and runs out of the crease to pick up a bye.. Sanju fires the throw and misses.. Faulkner gathers the ball, he fires in a throw again as Mishra is still out of the crease.. He misses again.. Now Sanju takes it and he finally manages to strike the stumps.. Mishra could have saved himself but he had given himself up to the mercy of this funny game between Samson and Faulkner.. Irfan Pathan doesn't move, he had the best seat

name: B Kumar
commentary: No Commentary

name: AM Rahane
commentary: first wicket! This is a loose loose shot! He comes forward to this length delivery and pushes at it away from the body, giving a simple head-high catch to the point fielder

name: KK Nair
commentary: gets the wicket finally! Another back of length delivery swinging away from the batsman, the batsman pokes at it but only gets an outside edge to the keeper..

name: SV Samson
commentary: superb ball! Samson gives it away. It was tossed up on the off and middle, the drift brings it in, the loop draws Samson out of the crease.. But it doesn't turn, keeps going straight to hit the top of middle

name: SR Watson
commentary: big big wicket! The tide is turning in Sunrises' favour.. Loose shot from Watson as he tries to cut this short of length delivery, it was too close to cut really.. He gets a faint nick to the keeper

name: STR Binny
commentary: Warner you beauty! This is sensational stuff. The batsman dabs it to midwicket and calls for a second.. This looked like a two.. but Warner hared in, swooped the ball and hit the stumps direct at non-striker's end.. Binny has to go back.. Binny is way way short..

name: SPD Smith
commentary: They are all on fire! Pathan completes an excellent catch.. With time running out, Smith looks for the big shot at this quick length delivery, he only manages a big top-edge. Irfan runs backwards from mid-off to settle under it

name: R Bhatia
commentary: slower delivery, Bhatia swings this time.. he goes towards deep midwicket.. again more height than distance.. Warner takes a simple catch

name: JP Faulkner
commentary: slower delivery, Faukner has no option but to swing at it, he hits in the right area, plays his natural game, but unfortunately it doesn't work for him today .. Finch comes round from long on to take a neat catch

name: KW Richardson
commentary: slower ball, batsman swings, this time it doesn't even go beyond the square.. it goes high, touches the moon, but on its wayback, meets the bowler.. who was running backwards.. Superb catch again

name: DS Kulkarni
commentary: No Commentary

name: PV Tambe
commentary: Game over! Tambe chips the length delivery straight to Steyn at long-off

name: V Sehwag
commentary: Sehwag falls in the first over of spin, charges out to a flighted ball on off, tries to launch Chahal over long on but he's only gone as far as the fielder

name: Mandeep Singh
commentary: Mandeep's tried to launch this full and wide one down the ground, but he's mishit it tamely to mid on, he's struggled to time the ball tonight, and the struggle is over now

name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: Maxwell lives and falls by the slog sweep, Chahal bowls a flat legbreak on middle, Maxwell goes down on his knee and swats it, Starc is around on the edge of the deep midwicket rope, and it helps that he is tall

name: DA Miller
commentary: he's tried to place this full toss wide of sweeper cover again, but he has to clear extra cover first, and Chahal has dived to his right to take a sharp catch there, but his effort could be in vain, Aaron seems to have just overstepped, his foot is on the line, but does not seem to have any part behind it, but Miller's been given, oh well

name: GJ Bailey
commentary: Bailey's gone, he never looked in touch tonight, Morkel angles it in, just short of a length, close to off, Bailey goes pushing at it, and edges it behind

name: WP Saha
shorttext: c de Villiers b HV Patel
commentary: a wide slower one, Saha mishits it high and AB comes in from long off to take it, he then throws it right back at Harshal and the bowler goes down, he's taken some blows this over

name: MG Johnson
commentary: No Commentary

name: AR Patel
commentary: he tries to make some room, but Starc is fast, right in the blockhole, and into middle stump before Patel can do anything about it

name: Shivam Sharma
commentary: Starc angles it in from round the stumps, Shivam makes room and swings, the yorker slips under the arc and hits the stumps second time in the over

name: L Balaji
commentary: No Commentary

name: CH Gayle
commentary: Sandeep's got Gayle again, anges it across Gayle, on a good length around off, it starts swinging away, Gayle goes after it, and edges it through to the keeper

name: PA Patel
shorttext: c Mandeep Singh b Sandeep Sharma
commentary: he's gone this time, Parthiv makes some room, comes out and tries to loft the length ball over the off side, he ends up slicing it, and they have a sweeper in place to take the catch

name: V Kohli
commentary: this is a very, very late reaction from the umpire on the appeal, but he's given Kohli, the batsman moved across to a length ball which was angled down the leg side, tried to flick it, there was a clear sound as ball passed the bat, it was dying on the keeper, he took it in his right glove, but it seems to have just brushed the ground for an instant after that, they go to the third umpire, it is not a front-foot no-ball, and they think the catch is also clean

name: S Rana
commentary: Akshar strikes now, Rana goes back to a quick and flat length delivery, it comes in with the angle, and crashes into middle stump

name: AB de Villiers
commentary: no miracle from AB tonight, Balaji goes full and wide, AB reaches out and slices it high and safely into the hands of sweeper cover

name: Yuvraj Singh
commentary: Yuvraj's struggle is over for tonight, he skips out, tries to go over midwicket, the turn takes the outside edge, and slip is waiting, Sehwag takes a sharp catch in front of his face, maiden IPL wicket for Shivam Sharma

name: JA Morkel
commentary: Morkel has had one hit too many, he goes back and tries to pull a length offbreak, Bailey takes the top edge at short third man

name: MA Starc
commentary: Starc clears front leg and slices a slog high in the air, Miller wants the catch, he runs in a long way from long on, dives forward and holds on

name: HV Patel
commentary: Johnson responds with a 144.5 kph short ball, Harshal tries to make room but it cramps him on leg stump, he opens the face and glides it straight to the keeper

name: VR Aaron
commentary: No Commentary

name: YS Chahal
commentary: No Commentary

name: Q de Kock
commentary: caught at cover! De Kock has looked nervy today and he's been dismissed in such a tame way. He got on the front foot to a length ball and drove away from his body, hitting it on the up straight to Rahul at cover

name: KP Pietersen
commentary: KP's gone! Too hasty too early against the leggie! That's Mishra's 100th IPL wicket too. KP gave Mishra the charge  and tried to loft over the off side, he wasn't to the pitch of the legbreak and mis-timed it straight to Dhawan, who caught it at head height at cover

name: MA Agarwal
commentary: he's holed out to deep midwicket! Mayank plonked his foot forward, got down on one knee, and tried to slog the legbreak for six. He only got as far as David Warner on the boundary

name: KD Karthik
commentary: Steyn's taken a blinder on the long-off boundary! Karthik sliced a high full toss down to long off, mis-timing it but hitting it well enough to clear the boundary had Steyn not been right on the edge. Steyn waited, positioned himself, jumped backward, arched his back and then landed back inside the boundary. The ball was in the airspace over the boundary when Steyn caught it

name: LR Shukla
commentary: Shukla's holed out for 21 off 22 balls. Henriques bowled a slower ball and Shukla slogged wildly, hitting it straight to Warner at deep midwicket. Both set batsmen have been dismissed and Duminy and Jadhav have to make the most of three overs without having faced a ball each.

name: JP Duminy
commentary: it's all going pear-shaped for Delhi. Duminy's lost his leg stump. He moved towards the off side to paddle a full ball homing in on leg stump from round the wicket. Duminy missed and leg stump was uprooted. Two run and a wicket in the over. Delhi have been winded.

name: KM Jadhav
commentary: a full toss outside off stump, Jadhav slogs at it and ends up slicing it over backward point, Irfan covers good ground, running back from the circle and catches the ball as it drops over his head. That's the first time Jadhav's been dismissed this IPL season, in his fifth innings.

name: R Shukla
commentary: No Commentary

name: AJ Finch
commentary: bowled him! Shukla delivers full and straight, Finch swings across the line and misses. Leg stump takes a beating. Delhi could pull off an unlikely win here! With Finch gone and Warner off strike, they have a new batsman to bowl to in a pressure situation.

name: S Dhawan
commentary: slapped it straight to one of the three men square on the off side! JP was at point, had to move a couple of steps to his left and holds on as Dhawan cuts one that didn't have as much room and didn't bother to keep it down.

name: DA Warner
commentary: No Commentary

name: NV Ojha
commentary: No Commentary

name: LMP Simmons
commentary: he's gone. clears his front leg, swings hard, but can only hit it down long-on's throat.

name: CM Gautam
commentary: and he's gone! It was too far outside off for him to control the sweep. Gautam goes for it anyway, and it loops up, off the outside edge, straight to McCullum at square leg.

name: AT Rayudu
commentary: Slower ball, big step back and across, and out comes the slog. Doesn't time it at all and the ball drops into Jadeja's hands. He barely had to move at deep midwicket. The batsmen didn't even cross, which means Anderson won't be on strike next ball.

name: RG Sharma
commentary: gone! Raina takes a good catch running to his left as Rohit tries to slog the carrom ball. It was high over his shoulder, but Raina took it with both hands before going on a tumble with the momentum.

name: KA Pollard
commentary: whatay catch! slow carrom ball, and Pollard's top hand comes off as he slogs at it. Connects fairly well, and Raina, running to his right, takes it the Australian way, hands pointing up, but it nearly pops out. He somehow keeps it in his grasp as he falls to the floor.

name: CJ Anderson
commentary: No Commentary

name: AP Tare
commentary: Full-toss, and Tare hits it over the leg side. He seems to hit that well, but Faf pops up out of nowhere to take what was in the end a pretty simple catch.

name: DR Smith
commentary: same shot, different result. Doesn't get as much behind it this time, and it drops to Simmons, who juggles it and takes it on the third attempt.

name: BB McCullum
commentary: Given! McCullum is hit on the front pad as he tries to pull. That definitely looked like it was going down the leg side. You could see both middle and off stump on the replay, from straight-on.

name: SK Raina
commentary: he's gone, is he? Fires it down the leg side as he sees Raina stepping down the pitch. Gautam collects brilliantly down the leg side and has the bails off in a flash. Raina turned around just as quick, though, and he's got his bat in, is it? Or is it in the air when the bails come off? It's hard to tell for sure, but the third umpire seems to think there is. OUT, flashes the big screen. Brave decision, that.

name: F du Plessis
commentary: what a ball! slower ball, right up in the blockhole. It hits the base of the stumps, in fact, after dipping under Faf's flailing bat. It seemed to hang in the air before dipping at the last moment.

name: MS Dhoni
commentary: No Commentary

name: RA Jadeja
commentary: got him! widish yorker, and Jadeja inside-edges it onto his stumps as he tries to chop down on it and take a single into the off side.

name: M Manhas
commentary: he's gone! inswinging yorker, inside-edged to fine leg. They take on PK's arm, and it isn't the best throw, on the bounce to Gautam, but he still manages to get the bails off before Manhas can slide in. It's in the air, moreover, as it crosses the crease. Third umpire takes a long time, but finally gives it out.

name: R Ashwin
commentary: No Commentary

name: V Sehwag
commentary: whoops. Sehwag comes down the track this time, slogs, and inside edges onto off stump.

name: Mandeep Singh
commentary: he's gone. Slightly shorter than the previous ball, straightened a touch perhaps, Mandeep tries to square-cut off the front foot, and gets a thick edge to the keeper.

name: WP Saha
commentary: Got him! back of a length, angling in. Saha tries to chop it into the off side, but only gets an inside-edge onto the stumps.

name: GJ Maxwell
commentary: and he's gone. This won't be Maxwell's day. slog-sweeps uppishly, straight to Morne Morkel on the deep square leg boundary.

name: DA Miller
commentary: got him! that was an offcutter, and it sneaked between bat and pad as Miller played across it. Crashed into middle stump.

name: GJ Bailey
commentary: No Commentary

name: R Dhawan
commentary: bowled him! skids on again, hits off stump as Dhawan tries to sweep it square.

name: MG Johnson
commentary: down the pitch, and Narine's offbreak spins past his swishing blade. Uthappa stumps him easily.

name: AR Patel
commentary: chipped to long-on. They try to run two, but Akshar is way out of his crease and the fielder did well to throw to the batsman's end.

name: RV Uthappa
commentary: he timed that too well! Awana drifts onto the pads again, and Uthappa picks it up and hits it over the leg side, Akshar runs to his left to take a good catch at deep midwicket.

name: G Gambhir
commentary: No Commentary

name: MK Pandey
commentary: No Commentary

name: V Kohli
commentary: superb start for the Royals so far, and it has just got better. There have been quite a few dots, and few singles, so Kohli throws his bat at this wide delivery. The ball moves away a touch to take a thick edge that flies all the way to third man

name: CH Gayle
commentary: Gayle is not reading this wrong'uns, but he is a fair man as this ball shows. Goes to cut, edges the googly, Samson takes a sharp catch, and Gayle walks. Turns out Tucker has his arms raised to call it a wide, but Gayle has walked away. Well played, Chris. Another example of ordinary umpiring this IPL

name: VH Zol
commentary: Turns out watching the legspinner's hand is out of fashion. Even Zol is not picking the wrong'un even though Tewatia has bowled seven googlies out of seven. Zol reads this off the pitch, which is too late, and he gives slip catching practice as this is pitched short of a length, and turns away to take the edge of a nothing poke

name: AB de Villiers
commentary: full and wide, takes it outside AB's reach, who is looking to stay back and hit, and consequently doesn't get all of this one, and holes out to deep cover

name: Yuvraj Singh
commentary: moves across again to open up the leg side but is beaten. Given out leg-before, but I am not sure it wasn't going down with the angle. Yuvraj walks off to a huge applause from the home crowd. What hitting

name: JA Morkel
commentary: No Commentary

name: PA Patel
commentary: No Commentary

name: AM Rahane
commentary: and Chahal is having it too. A wicket first ball. Skiddy legbreak, doesn't bounce much, Rahane goes to cut, gets a bottom edge, and PP latches on

name: KK Nair
commentary: Yuvraj is on an absolute roll here. One of the best all-round performances of all time in T20 cricket? Nair dances down, misses a straight ball, and has his middle stump pegged back

name: SR Watson
commentary: when it is your evening, it is often your night. Yuvraj pulls out a beauty. The arm ball. Watson is caught back to a length ball. It squeezes under the bat, and uproots the leg stump. Is MS Dhoni watching? Yuvraj the bowler has always been here even though the batsman has gone missing from time to time

name: STR Binny
shorttext: c sub (RR Rossouw) b Yuvraj Singh
commentary: Yuvi has got two wickets in one over. How can this night get any better? Stuart Binny, sent in to pinch-hit, dances down and gets a thick edge to deep cover

name: SV Samson
commentary: long hop to make it three for Yuvi. tonight is a good good night for YS. Drags this down, but it stops a touch on him, and Samson is a little casual, and lobs this back to Yuvraj

name: SPD Smith
commentary: No Commentary

name: JP Faulkner
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad
name: AJ Finch
commentary: caught at long-off! It was the ideal delivery to hit out - length and at a slower pace - but Finch hasn't been timing his shots lately and scoops it straight down the ground. Pollard from long-off moves to his right to take this comfortably

venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad
name: S Dhawan
commentary: middle stump is out! Dhawan wasn't looking very comfortable and now he has been cleaned up. It's not quite a yorker - some would say it's a half-volley - but this one came in to Dhawan, who went for a loose drive and played outside the line

venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad
name: KL Rahul
commentary: trouble! trouble! This is suicidal. Rahul pushes it straight to cover and charges out of the crease only to realise that it was a terrible call a bit too late. He was half-way down the pitch, makes a frantic return but was always going to be short

venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad
name: DA Warner
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad
name: NV Ojha
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad
name: LMP Simmons
commentary: perfect yorker from Bhuvi! Simmons doesn't help his case by exposing his stumps as he looks for the ramp shot, it takes out the off stick

venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad
name: CM Gautam
commentary: doesn't wait too long to strike! Gautam charges down the pitch and punches the length delivery straight to Dhawan at mid-off, this came in after pitching, messing the batsman's timing

venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad
name: AT Rayudu
commentary: what reflexes from Henriques! That was short and was flat-batted back to the bowler, who stuck out his hands over his head and caught it in the second attempt.

venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad
name: RG Sharma
commentary: No Commentary

venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad
name: KA Pollard
commentary: No Commentary

name: Ankit Sharma
commentary: caught at long-on! Ankit slogged an offbreak from outside off stump and for the awkward way he made contact he hit it pretty far, Dwayne Smith was right on the edge of the boundary when he took the catch

name: SR Watson
commentary: middle stump has taken a beating! Mohit bowled it full and straight, Watson aimed the slog at the midwicket boundary and missed, that's that. The ball kept a bit low

name: AM Rahane
commentary: Rahane's been run out! He pushed it off the front foot towards cover and ran. There was no single there but Watson had taken a few steps out of his crease and was late in sending Rahane back. By the time he had turned, Rahane had no chance. McCullum had swooped on the ball and under-armed it back to Dhoni

name: KK Nair
commentary: bowled him! Badree ends his spell with a wicket but Rajasthan won't mind that at all. Nair went back to cut one that was a bit too full and got a bottom edge onto off stump. That will bring in Smith, Faulkner and the rest ...

name: STR Binny
commentary: caught at long-on, the Royal slump continues. Binny simply hit it straight to du Plessis with the bottom of his bat. All very average from Rajasthan

name: SPD Smith
commentary: what a crazy shot. Smith began to play the scoop, but then saw that the ball was full and straight, and then tried to play some sort of a ramp. He ended up playing nothing and losing leg stump

name: JP Faulkner
commentary: bowled him! Faulkner's been done by the quicker, skiddy ball that goes straight on. Faulkner tries to work the ball through square leg but misses, the ball goes off the pad and knocks back leg stump

name: DH Yagnik
commentary: No Commentary
